all.summary: Mobile marketplace tabs never use the public variant, dropping How It Works/Blog
all.why: Header.tsx:917 picks only venueMarketplaceTabs or marketplaceTabs; publicMarketplaceTabs (line 27) is desktop-only. Footer still carries the links, so impact is a minor nav inconsistency.
all.fix: In the mobile menu, mirror the desktop variant selection including the public tab set for logged-out users.

all.summary: Customer accounts' header messages dropdown always shows 'No messages yet'
all.why: Header.tsx:222-246 resolves slug only via /api/artist-profile and /api/venue-profile; customers have neither, so the fetch never runs. customer-portal/messages/page.tsx:14 uses slugify(displayName) instead.
all.fix: Add a customer branch to slug resolution using the same slugify(displayName) fallback the customer portal uses.

all.summary: Role-switch passes &hint= that /login never reads, dropping the target role
all.why: Header.tsx:818 pushes /login?email=...&hint=...; login/page.tsx reads only ?email= (line 34), no 'hint' reference anywhere in the login directory.
all.fix: Read ?hint= on /login and show 'Signing into your X account' plus route post-login to that portal.

all.summary: Cookie banner Decline and Accept are functionally identical
all.why: Only CookieBanner.tsx and CookieConsentContext.tsx reference the consent value; nothing else reads it and no non-essential cookies exist to decline.
all.fix: Replace Accept/Decline with a single OK dismiss for the essential-only notice.

all.summary: Homepage lacks skip link, DemoBanner and FeedbackBubble
all.why: src/app/page.tsx sits outside (pages), rendering its own Header/Footer with no skip link; (pages)/layout.tsx:19-34 provides skip link, DemoBanner and FeedbackBubble that / never gets.
all.fix: Add the skip link, DemoBanner and FeedbackBubble to page.tsx, or move / into the (pages) group.

all.summary: Social shares 404 on /og-image.png
all.why: public/ has no og-image.png, but src/app/opengraph-image.tsx generates a site-wide og:image, and file-based metadata overrides layout.tsx:47's config. Only twitter.images (layout.tsx:60) still references the missing file.
all.fix: Delete the stale /og-image.png entries from layout.tsx metadata, or add a matching twitter-image.tsx.

all.summary: Homepage trust bar counts come from static seed; /api/stats/public has zero callers
all.why: page.tsx:22-32 buckets artists.ts/venues.ts counts; grep finds no caller of /api/stats/public. The code comment documents this as a deliberate choice.
all.fix: Wire the trust bar to /api/stats/public with the seed as fallback, or delete the endpoint.

all.summary: Three fabricated named testimonials with invented sales outcomes presented as genuine
all.why: page.tsx:363-386: source comment admits names/roles are placeholders, yet quotes claim specific sales ('four sales straight off the wall this quarter'). Fake consumer testimonials are a banned practice under UK consumer law.
all.fix: Remove the testimonials section, or clearly label it illustrative, before launch.

all.summary: NavCard, DealCard, ValueBlock defined but never used
all.why: page.tsx:501,528,592 define them; grep finds no call sites anywhere in the file or elsewhere.
all.fix: Delete the three unused components.

all.summary: About page says 'We handle everything from there' contradicting its own logistics copy
all.why: about/page.tsx:118-119 says 'We handle everything from there' while lines 66-67 and 200-201 say delivery/installation are arranged between artist and venue.
all.fix: Reword the onboarding card to 'we match you with venues; you arrange delivery together'.

all.summary: 'Many successful artists are accepted on their second application' is a fabricated track record
all.why: ArtistGuide.tsx:152 (rendered on /artists) makes a claim no pre-launch product can have data for; the feedback-on-every-application promise also lacks a wired admin flow.
all.fix: Reword to 'you're welcome to reapply after three months' and drop the second-application claim.

all.summary: 'Most of our artists use Parcelforce, DHL...' is an invented usage statistic
all.why: faqs/page.tsx:117-120 asserts courier usage of a user base that does not exist yet (the copy lives on /faqs, not /artists as the flag's section implies).
all.fix: Rephrase as a recommendation: 'we suggest Parcelforce, DHL, or specialist art couriers'.

all.summary: Two different payment-timing descriptions: 'within 14 days' versus escrow-until-delivery
all.why: ArtistGuide.tsx:162 says paid 'within 14 days via bank transfer'; faqs/page.tsx:90-95 says funds held until delivery confirmed or 14 days without dispute. Same fact, different framing.
all.fix: Adopt the /faqs escrow wording in the ArtistGuide FAQ.

all.summary: 'SEE VENUE DEMAND' and 'SEARCH BY POSTCODE' both link plain /spaces
all.why: ArtistGuide.tsx:410-414: both Links have href=/spaces with no anchor or query differentiating them.
all.fix: Point the second CTA at the postcode input anchor on /spaces, or delete it.

all.summary: Customers clicking Message on /spaces are routed into /venue-portal/messages
all.why: spaces/page.tsx:680: portalBase ternary is artist-or-venue only, while canMessageVenues (line 201) admits customers; a customer lands in a portal they cannot access.
all.fix: Add a customer branch routing to /customer-portal/messages.

all.summary: 'Upgrade to Premium to message venues' branch is unreachable
all.why: spaces/page.tsx:194 and 201 define canSeeDetails and canMessageVenues as identical expressions, so canSeeDetails && !canMessageVenues (line 693) can never be true.
all.fix: Delete the dead branch, or differentiate the gates if messaging is meant to be Premium-only.

all.summary: 'Apply for Pro' lands on the form with Core preselected
all.why: pricing/page.tsx:297 links plain /apply; ApplicationForm.tsx:166 defaults selectedPlan 'core' and reads no searchParams, so the Pro intent is dropped.
all.fix: Link /apply?plan=pro and have ApplicationForm read the param into selectedPlan.

all.summary: Pricing cancellation FAQ contradicts Terms and promises an artwork-return service
all.why: pricing/page.tsx:94 says 'We will arrange the return of any artwork'; terms/page.tsx:229-230 and faqs/page.tsx:159 both make the artist collect within 30 days. Marketing contradicts the binding contract.
all.fix: Align the pricing FAQ with the Terms: 30 days' notice, artist collects their own work.
all.challenge: Copy conflict where Terms govern; harm needs an actual cancellation dispute, near-zero at launch volume. Rubric calls this a minor copy conflict.

all.summary: 'We accept around half' is an invented acceptance rate
all.why: HowItWorksClient.tsx:35 and apply/page.tsx:26 both state an acceptance rate a pre-launch platform has no data for.
all.fix: Soften to 'we review every application personally and accept selectively'.

all.summary: 'Browse hundreds of storefronts' overstates a roughly 40-artist catalogue
all.why: HowItWorksClient.tsx:45 and customer/page.tsx:42 claim hundreds; src/data/artists.ts holds 39 artist entries and the live DB is smaller.
all.fix: Change to 'browse dozens of independent artists' or drop the number.
all.challenge: 'Hundreds of storefronts' against a roughly 39-artist catalogue is materially false copy on a primary buyer-funnel page, falsified one click later.

all.summary: Certificate-of-authenticity promised to buyers; no such feature exists
all.why: HowItWorksClient.tsx:48 and CustomerGuide.tsx:43-45,106 promise a signed certificate with every sale; grep finds no certificate generation, order attachment, or Artist Agreement obligation anywhere.
all.fix: Remove the certificate claims until the feature or an artist obligation exists.
all.challenge: A signed certificate is a physical artefact fulfillable manually at launch volume, or a one-line copy edit; operational promise, not a software gate.

all.summary: Venue tab arrangements step omits the paid-loan option
all.why: HowItWorksClient.tsx:29 lists only free display and outright purchase, while page.tsx:212, spaces/page.tsx:538 and ApplicationForm.tsx:738-745 treat paid loan as first-class.
all.fix: Add paid loan to the venue step 03 description.

all.summary: FAQ promises onboarding call within a week and first-interest-in-2-3-weeks stat
all.why: faqs/page.tsx:69-77 commits to a 1-working-day email, an onboarding call within a week, and an invented 'most artists' statistic, all unverifiable pre-launch.
all.fix: Keep the email promise, soften the call to 'we'll invite you', delete the statistic.

all.summary: FAQs promise 24-hour replies while the acknowledgement email says 2 days
all.why: faqs/page.tsx:379 says 24 hours; api/contact/route.ts:12 sets EXPECTED_REPLY_DAYS = 2, so the email arriving seconds later contradicts the page.
all.fix: Pick one number and use it in both the pages and EXPECTED_REPLY_DAYS.

all.summary: Sustainability page renders a space before a comma
all.why: sustainability/page.tsx:124-125: 'the lifetime journey of a work\n , first studio' puts a leading space before the comma in rendered output.
all.fix: Rejoin the JSX line so the comma follows 'work' directly.

all.summary: Contact page promises 24 hours; its own acknowledgement email promises 2 days
all.why: ContactForm.tsx:102 and contact/page.tsx:50 say 24 hours; api/contact/route.ts:12 EXPECTED_REPLY_DAYS = 2 drives the email sent for the same submission.
all.fix: Align both to one figure, same change as A24.

all.summary: Contact reference number is emailed but never returned to the page
all.why: api/contact/route.ts:113 returns only { success: true }; the reference (line 46) never reaches ContactForm's success screen, so a mistyped email loses it entirely.
all.fix: Return reference in the JSON and display it on the success screen.

all.summary: Artist-message double-post never checks the /api/enquiry response
all.why: ContactForm.tsx:56-67 awaits the enquiry fetch without checking res.ok; a failed enquiry with a successful contact insert still shows 'They'll be notified by email.'
all.fix: Check the enquiry response and adjust the success copy or surface an error when it fails.

all.summary: Cookie policy documents sb-access/refresh-token cookies the auth flow never sets
all.why: cookies/page.tsx:15,23 list those cookies; src/lib/supabase.ts uses plain createClient (localStorage sessions), no @supabase/ssr in package.json, and only /api/demo/login writes any sb-* cookie.
all.fix: Rewrite the policy to describe localStorage session storage and the demo-login cookie.

all.summary: Policy lists wallplace_cookie_consent as a 12-month cookie; reality is a localStorage key
all.why: cookies/page.tsx:31,35 versus CookieConsentContext.tsx:5: actual key is wallplace-cookie-consent (hyphens) in localStorage with no expiry. Wrong name, mechanism and duration in a legal document.
all.fix: Correct the entry to the real key name, localStorage mechanism, and no expiry.

all.summary: Blog index excerpt is raw markdown sliced to 240 characters
all.why: blog/page.tsx:162 renders (post.body_markdown ?? '').slice(0, 240) verbatim, so headings and image syntax show literally on the index.
all.fix: Strip markdown syntax before slicing the excerpt.

all.summary: Blog post body renders markdown as literal syntax in plain paragraphs
all.why:
blog/[slug]/page.tsx:302-303 splits body_markdown on blank lines into

; no markdown parser anywhere, so artist-authored headings, links and images display as raw syntax publicly.
all.fix: Render body_markdown through a sanitised markdown renderer, or constrain the editor to plain text.

all.summary: Waitlist silently discards phone, venueName and venueLocation
all.why: waitlist/page.tsx:31 posts six fields; validations.ts:17-21 waitlistSchema accepts only name, email, userType, so zod strips the other three and the insert never stores them.
all.fix: Add the three optional fields to waitlistSchema and the insert, or remove them from the form.
all.challenge: The lead (name, email, userType) is stored; dropped fields are optional enrichment recoverable by email follow-up. Funnel intact.

all.summary: Waitlist page claims 'private beta' while signup, apply and venue registration are open
all.why: waitlist/page.tsx:452-453 says join the waitlist for an invitation; /signup, /apply and /signup/venue are all open, so a warm prospect may wait indefinitely.
all.fix: Replace the private-beta paragraph with a line linking straight to the open signup.

all.summary: Upvote toggle shows no pressed state, so un-voting looks like a glitch
all.why: feature-requests/page.tsx tracks only upvotes counts (lines 16,112-117); the toggle endpoint returns upvoted but the UI and list GET never expose per-user state.
all.fix: Return per-user upvoted in the list API and render an aria-pressed highlighted state.

all.summary: Feature-requests page has no metadata title
all.why: feature-requests/page.tsx is 'use client' with no layout.tsx in its directory, so the tab shows the root default title.
all.fix: Add a layout.tsx exporting metadata with a title.

all.summary: Demo login sets an ssr-format cookie nothing in the app reads; portal tour lands logged out
all.why: api/demo/login/route.ts:117-146 sets httpOnly sb-<ref>-auth-token; package.json has no @supabase/ssr, no middleware.ts exists, and the client is localStorage-based supabase-js, so the portal sees no session.
all.fix: Redirect with tokens to a client page calling supabase.auth.setSession, or adopt @supabase/ssr.

all.summary: Demo sign-in failure shows the visitor a raw JSON error page
all.why: demo/page.tsx:112-113 uses a plain Link to /api/demo/login; the route's 500/503 paths (route.ts:76-113) return JSON directly to the navigated browser tab.
all.fix: Redirect failures to /demo?error=1 and render a friendly fallback there.

all.summary: /customer repeats the 'hundreds of independent artists' overclaim
all.why: customer/page.tsx:42 says hundreds; the seed catalogue is 39 artists and the live DB smaller. Same family as A20.
all.fix: Reword to 'dozens' or drop the number, together with A20.
all.challenge: Same 'hundreds of independent artists' overclaim on /customer, the buyer landing page; trust-damaging false copy on a high-traffic funnel surface.

all.summary: CustomerGuide repeats the certificate-of-authenticity promise
all.why: CustomerGuide.tsx:43-45 ('Every sale ships with a signed certificate') and 106 repeat the promise; no certificate feature exists anywhere in src. Same defect as A21.
all.fix: Remove the certificate claims alongside A21.
all.challenge: Duplicate of A21; the same copy fix resolves both.

all.summary: No resend-verification option on /check-your-inbox
all.why: check-your-inbox/page.tsx has no resend reference; the resend endpoint is surfaced only on /login after a failed sign-in (login/page.tsx:201-206).
all.fix: Add a resend button on /check-your-inbox calling /api/auth/resend-verification.

all.summary: Artist signup promises going straight to the application but routes to /check-your-inbox
all.why: signup/artist/page.tsx:295-298 says 'Continue to Application' / 'straight to the application form'; line 121 pushes /check-your-inbox, and the doc comment (lines 28-34) still describes a removed signInWithPassword hop.
all.fix: Reword button and helper to 'check your inbox to verify, then apply'; update the doc comment.

all.summary: 'Other' venue type free-text is stripped by validation and never stored
all.why: signup/venue/page.tsx:163 posts the whole form; validations.ts:84-98 registerVenueSchema has no customVenueType, so zod strips it and the record stores only 'Other'.
all.fix: Add customVenueType to registerVenueSchema and merge it into the stored venueType.
all.challenge: Venue's typed 'Other' description is silently stripped by zod and never stored; the rubric's P1 class of forms silently discarding user input.

all.summary: Venue confirmation email frames open registration as an application under review
all.why: api/register-venue/route.ts:96 and VenueRegistrationConfirmation.tsx:41 use subject 'We've received your Wallplace application', while signup/venue/page.tsx:278 promises 'start browsing immediately. No waiting.'
all.fix: Change subject and body to a welcome / confirm-your-email framing.
all.challenge: Every venue signup email claims 'application received', implying review; venues wait for approval that never comes. False transactional copy stalling the venue funnel.

all.summary: Venue signup success screen is dead code; setSubmitted never called
all.why: signup/venue/page.tsx:93 declares the state, line 219 renders it, but the submit handler routes to /check-your-inbox (line 209) and nothing calls setSubmitted(true).
all.fix: Delete the submitted state and its success screen.

all.summary: Venue signup hero renders 'Wallplace Curated , paid shortlists'
all.why: signup/venue/page.tsx:259-263: the Link and ' , paid shortlists from £49.' are split across JSX lines, producing a space before the comma.
all.fix: Rejoin the JSX so the comma follows the link with no space.

all.summary: Login password minLength 6 versus 8 on both signup forms
all.why: login/page.tsx:176 minLength={6}; signup/artist/page.tsx:191 and signup/venue/page.tsx:350 enforce 8. Harmless for existing passwords, just inconsistent.
all.fix: Drop the login minLength or set it to 8 for consistency.

all.summary: /apply hero repeats the invented 'We accept roughly half' acceptance rate
all.why: apply/page.tsx:26 states the same fabricated statistic as HowItWorksClient.tsx:35 on a platform with no application history.
all.fix: Soften to 'we review every application personally', together with A19.

all.summary: Wrong-role 'Create artist account' CTA loops forever without signing out
all.why: ApplicationGate.tsx:80 links /signup/artist?next=/apply with no signOut; RedirectIfLoggedIn.tsx:23-29 bounces any signed-in user straight back to /apply, re-rendering the same notice.
all.fix: Have the button call supabase.auth.signOut() before navigating to /signup/artist?next=/apply.
all.challenge: Only signed-in wrong-role users visiting /apply hit it; manual sign-out via header recovers. Confusing loop, not a funnelled dead surface.

all.summary: /api/apply never checks the submitted email against the authenticated user
all.why: api/apply/route.ts:28-29 fetches the auth user but only for the profile bridge; d.email (line 65) is stored and mailed unchecked, so an authed user can file applications and trigger emails for any address.
all.fix: When authenticated, reject or overwrite the email with authedUser.email.
all.challenge: Apply deliberately accepts a typed contact email like any contact form; rate-limited 5/min; abuse vector is ordinary contact-form grade.

all.summary: Cooling-off acknowledgement is stripped by applySchema and never persisted
all.why: ApplicationForm.tsx:270 posts acknowledgedCoolingOff; validations.ts applySchema (lines 39-82) has no such field, so zod strips it and no row column records the consumer-rights evidence.
all.fix: Add acknowledgedCoolingOff to applySchema and store it on the application row.
all.challenge: Checkbox is shown and ticked; only persistence is lost. Evidentiary gap, consumer rights themselves unaffected; harm speculative until a dispute.

all.summary: Receipt email says 3-day review; every page says 5 business days
all.why: api/apply/route.ts:258 passes reviewTimelineDays: 3, while page.tsx:337, apply/page.tsx:106, faqs/page.tsx:62 and others all promise 5 business days.
all.fix: Change reviewTimelineDays to 5.

all.summary: /apply/claim signs up a fresh account for users who already have one and are signed in
all.why: ApplicationForm.tsx:310-343 funnels every applicant (authed, with a pending profile row from the apply bridge) to claim/page.tsx, which never checks auth, re-signUps, and signInWithPassword with a new password fails with a false 'Account created' message.
all.fix: Rewrite the page as a signed-in 'add bio and website' step, skipping signUp when a session exists.
all.challenge: Optional 'get a head start' CTA after the application already succeeded; the account already exists and normal login works. Confusing message, funnel intact.

all.summary: apply/claim defines a local slugify duplicating src/lib/slugify
all.why: claim/page.tsx:25-33 reimplements slugify; src/lib/slugify.ts already exists and is imported elsewhere (e.g. customer-portal/messages).
all.fix: Import slugify from @/lib/slugify and delete the local copy.

all.summary: Reset-password one-shot getSession can show a valid link as expired
all.why: reset-password/page.tsx:17-22 checks getSession once with no onAuthStateChange or retry, and line 49 renders 'Invalid or Expired Link' whenever hasSession is false, including while the SDK is still exchanging the recovery hash.
all.fix: Reuse the auth/callback retry loop (or subscribe to onAuthStateChange) and show a loading state first.

all.summary: /api/stats/public has zero callers
all.why: grep across src finds no fetch of /api/stats/public; the homepage trust bar it was built for uses the static seed (page.tsx:22-32).
all.fix: Wire the trust bar to it (with seed fallback) or delete the endpoint.

all.summary: requestGeolocation never called; 'Detecting your location' branches are dead code
all.why: browse/page.tsx line 790 defines requestGeolocation; grep shows no caller, setGeoRequesting only inside it, so geoRequesting stays false and all three branches (1214, 2178, 2576) are unreachable.
all.fix: Delete requestGeolocation, geoRequesting state and the three dead branches, or wire a 'Use my location' button.

all.summary: Artist filter badge over-counts by one via always-true mode check
all.why: browse/page.tsx line 1579 includes filters.mode === 'local' in the count array; mode is initialised 'local' (filterParams line 104) and never mutated, so one checkbox shows '2'.
all.fix: Remove filters.mode === 'local' from the count array.

all.summary: Empty portfolios grid wrongly blames missing postcode when other filters caused it
all.why: browse/page.tsx line 1774: filters.mode === 'local' is always true, so the postcode branch wins whenever coords are absent; the distance filter (line 888) only applies with coords, so the guidance misleads.
all.fix: Drop the mode check; show the postcode hint only when no other filter or search is active.

all.summary: Gallery 'Clear all' silently disables location filtering until reload
all.why: browse/page.tsx line 1176: clearGalleryFilters sets galleryLocationMode 'global'; line 1048 then skips the distance filter while the slider stays rendered; no UI ever sets it back, and filterParams serialises the non-default mode.
all.fix: Stop setting galleryLocationMode in clearGalleryFilters; the mode has no toggle and should stay 'local'.

all.summary: Collections 'Clear all' and mobile '!' badge render permanently
all.why: browse/page.tsx line 1156: hasCollectionsFilters includes collectionsLocationMode === 'local', initialised 'local' (line 606) with no UI setter, so the predicate is always true.
all.fix: Remove the collectionsLocationMode term from hasCollectionsFilters.

all.summary: Profile theme filter matches title+medium substrings, not theme tags
all.why: ArtistProfileClient.tsx lines 96-101 filter works by haystack of title + medium containing the theme string; works' actual theme tags are never consulted, so results are wrong both ways.
all.fix: Filter on the work's theme tags where present, falling back to the substring match only for untagged works.

all.summary: Floating-bar Buy Now adds last-entered tier, not the largest
all.why: ArtistProfileClient.tsx line 130 takes tiers[tiers.length - 1] with a 'largest tier' comment; pricing arrays keep artist entry order and are never sorted, while bulkAskingPrice (line 118) uses Math.max, so hint and cart can diverge.
all.fix: Pick the tier with the highest price instead of the last array entry.

all.summary: Lightbox has no 'No frame' option; first paid frame forced into purchase
all.why: ArtistProfileClient.tsx lines 905-913 map only frameOptions with selectedFrameIdx defaulting 0; the CTA (line 947) always applies frameOpts[selectedFrameIdx] uplift. ArtworkPageClient.tsx line 366 has the 'No frame' -1 option the lightbox lacks.
all.fix: Add a 'No frame' value -1 option and treat it as no uplift, mirroring ArtworkPageClient.
all.challenge: Frame uplift and total price shown transparently in the lightbox; unframed purchase available on the artwork page. No silent overcharge, alternative surface exists.

all.summary: Lightbox enquiry form always fails for guests and customers
all.why: ArtistProfileClient.tsx line 1152 sends the primary POST to /api/messages, whose handler (messages/route.ts lines 256-318) needs auth and 403s accounts without artist/venue profiles; /api/enquiry only fires after that succeeds, so guests and customers always get the error toast.
all.fix: For guests and customers, POST /api/enquiry directly and confirm on its success; keep /api/messages for venues.

all.summary: Frame dropdown '+£X' ignores per-size override the charge honours
all.why: ArtworkPageClient.tsx: charged frameUplift (lines 99-107) prefers pricesBySize; the dropdown row's scaledForRow (lines 373-407) computes only the perimeter ramp, so the two figures diverge whenever an artist sets explicit per-size frame prices.
all.fix: Extract one shared uplift function checking pricesBySize first and use it for both the row and the charge.

all.summary: Shipping info block quotes work-level price while cart charges per-size
all.why: ArtworkPageClient.tsx line 440 passes work.shippingPrice to resolveShippingCost, but effectiveShippingPrice (lines 149-152) preferring pricing[i].shippingPrice is what the cart lines (528, 563) carry, so quoted and charged delivery differ when per-size shipping is set.
all.fix: Pass effectiveShippingPrice as manualPrice in the shipping info block.

all.summary: Customer 'Message the artist' link lands in a 403-dead messages portal
all.why: ArtworkPageClient.tsx line 686 routes signed-in customers to /customer-portal/messages; MessageInbox hits /api/messages?slug= and POST, both of which 403 accounts without artist/venue profiles, so customers can neither load nor send. MessageArtistButton.tsx line 47 already routes customers to /contact.
all.fix: Route signed-in customers to /contact?artist=<slug>, matching MessageArtistButton.

all.summary: Collection work tiles link by UUID; artwork route resolves only slugified titles
all.why: collections/[collectionId]/page.tsx lines 268 and 302 build /browse/<artist>/<work.id> where id is the DB UUID (collections API line 80); [workSlug]/page.tsx line 92 matches only slugify(w.title), so notFound() fires on every DB-backed tile.
all.fix: Link to /browse/<artistSlug>/<slugify(work.title)> instead of work.id.

all.summary: 'Placed at' chip on collection tiles can never render
all.why: collections/[collectionId]/page.tsx line 354 reads work.placed_at_venue, but api/collections/[id]/route.ts builds each work object (lines 79-93) without that field, so the chip condition is always falsy.
all.fix: Include placed_at_venue in the API's work mapping, or delete the chip from this page.

all.summary: Collection sidebar labels paid-loan flag as 'Display'
all.why: collections/[collectionId]/page.tsx line 407 hardcodes 'Display' for openToFreeLoan; arrangement-labels.ts canonicalises free_loan as paid_loan ('Paid loan'), and BrowseArtistCard.tsx line 37 uses ARRANGEMENT_LABEL.paid_loan for the same flag.
all.fix: Use ARRANGEMENT_LABEL.paid_loan for the openToFreeLoan chip on this page.

all.summary: Signed-in customer's placement CTA links to /signup dead end
all.why: collections/[collectionId]/page.tsx lines 486-488: userType 'customer' gets /signup?next=<venue-portal URL> labelled 'Switch to a venue account'; signup cannot convert an existing account, so the flow dead-ends, though the comment shows it was deliberate.
all.fix: Link customers to an explainer (e.g. /partners or contact) or hide the CTA for customers.

all.summary: Venue-page request rows always link into the artist portal
all.why: venues/[slug]/VenueProfileBody.tsx line 243 hardcodes /artist-portal/artwork-requests/<id> for every viewer; ArtistPortalLayout.tsx line 103 router.replace('/login') for any non-artist, so signed-in customers and the venue owner hit a login bounce.
all.fix: Gate the link to artist viewers; render plain non-linked cards for everyone else.

all.summary: Collect tile shows machine slug instead of venue display name
all.why: checkout/page.tsx lines 79-81 set collectVenueName from items[0]?.collectVenueSlug; types.ts line 34 shows cart lines carry only the slug, so buyers see 'the-copper-kettle' in the copy at line 662.
all.fix: Carry collectVenueName on the cart line when adding, or humanise the slug for display.

all.summary: Visiting confirmation without a session wipes the cart
all.why: checkout/confirmation/page.tsx lines 66-70: clearCart() and clearQrContext() run unconditionally on mount, before the sessionId null-check, so any stray navigation to the URL destroys the visitor's cart.
all.fix: Only clear cart and QR context when sessionId is present (or after the session fetch succeeds).

all.summary: Confirmation never checks payment_status before asserting payment received
all.why: checkout/confirmation/page.tsx line 82 sets order whenever data.id exists; the API returns status (session/route.ts line 34) but the page renders 'Order Confirmed' and 'Payment of £X received' without ever reading it.
all.fix: Render the paid receipt only when status is 'paid'; otherwise show a hedged pending state.
all.challenge: Page claims 'Payment of £X received' without reading the returned Stripe status; unpaid or expired sessions get a false money-received assertion.

all.summary: Failed session lookup still asserts 'payment was received successfully'
all.why: checkout/confirmation/page.tsx lines 119-131: when sessionId is present but the fetch fails or returns no id, the fallback states 'Your payment was received successfully' and 'your order is confirmed', unverifiable and false for bogus ids.
all.fix: Hedge the fallback copy: 'If your payment completed you'll receive a confirmation email shortly.'
all.challenge: Asserts 'payment was received successfully' when the lookup failed entirely; an unverifiable money claim rendered for any bogus session id.

all.summary: 'Shipped by the artist, 5 to 7 days' shown for every order type
all.why: checkout/confirmation/page.tsx lines 197-206: the artist-fulfilment notice is unconditional in the success view, so collection and venue-collect orders are told they will be shipped, with a hardcoded window contradicting checkout's calculator.
all.fix: Hedge to fulfilment-neutral copy, or thread the fulfilment method through session metadata and branch.

all.summary: Confirmation links /browse/collections, which 404s in both views
all.why: checkout/confirmation/page.tsx lines 144 and 257 link /browse/collections; no page.tsx exists there, so it resolves to browse/[slug] with slug 'collections', getArtistBySlug fails and notFound() fires ([slug]/page.tsx line 154).
all.fix: Change both hrefs to /browse?view=collections.
all.challenge: Post-purchase convenience link; the buyer funnel already completed. Confusing 404, no funnel or money harm.

all.summary: Delivered step credits 'the carrier' though the buyer marks arrival
all.why: orders/[id]/page.tsx line 43 hints 'Marked as arrived by the carrier'; orders/route.ts line 25 puts 'delivered' in BUYER_STATUSES only, and no carrier integration exists, so the copy can stall buyers waiting on a carrier that never acts.
all.fix: Reword the hint to 'Marked as arrived by you' or similar buyer-attributed copy.

all.summary: 'Confirming delivery releases payment' overstates the button's effect
all.why: orders/[id]/events/route.ts POST only inserts an order.delivery_confirmed event (line 207); transfers actually execute on the delivered transition in orders/route.ts (line 188) or the 14-day cron, so payment is already released before this button.
all.fix: Reword: confirming records receipt; payment releases on delivery (or automatically after the hold period).

all.summary: Timeline reads h.at but writers store timestamp, so dates never render
all.why: orders/track/page.tsx line 273 reads h.at; orders/route.ts line 220 and webhooks/stripe/route.ts line 311 write { status, timestamp }, and track/route.ts line 108 passes status_history through raw, so h.at is always undefined.
all.fix: Read h.timestamp (with h.at fallback) in the track page timeline.

all.summary: Collect lines under a ship order keep in-store price, skip placement check
all.why: checkout/route.ts line 468 prices any lineFulfilment==='collect_venue' line at the in-store price regardless of order fulfilment, while placement re-validation (line 63) runs only for collect_venue orders; the checkout UI lets buyers pick 'Ship to me' with such lines.
all.fix: When order fulfilment is ship, re-price collect lines at the tier price or reject them with a 409.

all.summary: Requested quantity never compared to stock server-side
all.why: checkout/route.ts only runs isWorkSold (quantity_available <= 0) per line 258; qty vs quantity_available is never checked, so 10 can be bought with 2 in stock. But migration 085 clamps the decrement at GREATEST(0,...), so stock never goes negative as claimed.
all.fix: Reject lines where quantity exceeds the row's quantity_available in the checkout gate.
all.challenge: Lightbox caps quantity client-side, so exploiting needs a crafted request; clamp prevents negative stock; consequence is an oversell needing a refund, an admin task.

all.summary: POST /api/disputes has no buyer-facing entry point anywhere
all.why: grep shows no page or component calls /api/disputes (only admin/disputes reads the admin list and event-vocabulary.ts mentions it); orders/[id]/page.tsx offers only /contact links at lines 272 and 285.
all.fix: Add a 'Report a problem' form on the order page wired to POST /api/disputes.
all.challenge: FAQ ties payout release to 'buyer dispute', but no dispute entry point exists and processPendingTransfers never checks disputes; the promised buyer protection is unusable.

all.summary: Dispute emails deep-link /orders/<id>/dispute, a nonexistent route
all.why: disputes/route.ts line 130 builds /orders/<id>/dispute and the OrderDisputeOpened/Resolved templates use it; only src/app/(pages)/orders/[id]/page.tsx exists, so the link 404s. Currently latent because B29 means the emails cannot be triggered.
all.fix: Point disputeUrl at /orders/<id> (optionally with a #dispute anchor).

all.summary: Offer checkout cancel_url is /customer-portal/offers, which 404s
all.why: offers/[id]/checkout/route.ts line 202 sets cancel_url to /customer-portal/offers; customer-portal contains only addresses, messages, saved, settings, while offers live under /venue-portal/offers, so cancelling on Stripe lands mid-payment on a 404.
all.fix: Change cancel_url to /venue-portal/offers.
all.challenge: Only fires when the buyer deliberately cancels on Stripe; no money moved; back-navigation recovers. Not a funnel surface.

all.summary: Verify-email screen is a dead end with no resend or sign-out control
all.why: PortalGuard.tsx lines 119-131 render only heading and text; resend-verification is referenced solely in login/page.tsx. The global Header still offers sign-out, so the trap is partial.
all.fix: Add a resend button posting /api/auth/resend-verification plus a sign-out link to the PortalGuard notice.

all.summary: Failed /api/orders fetch renders the 'No orders yet' empty state
all.why: customer-portal/page.tsx lines 90-96: empty catch, loading ends; lines 442-447 show the empty state whenever orders.length is 0, including after a failed fetch.
all.fix: Track fetch failure in state and render an error message with a retry button instead of the empty state.

all.summary: Total Spent sums cancelled and refunded orders and hard-codes the pound sign
all.why: customer-portal/page.tsx line 163 reduces over every order regardless of status; line 212 renders £{totalSpent} while the detail view uses formatCurrency with order.currency.
all.fix: Exclude cancelled/refunded orders from the sum and format via formatCurrency, or per-currency subtotals.

all.summary: Emails, notifications and /orders/[id] link /customer-portal/orders, which 404s
all.why: No orders route under src/app/(pages)/customer-portal and no redirect in next.config.ts; senders confirmed at api/orders/route.ts 280/330, api/refunds/process/route.ts 157/421, orders/[id]/page.tsx 183.
all.fix: Add a next.config redirect from /customer-portal/orders to /customer-portal, mapping ?id= to ?order=.

all.summary: Blank partial-refund amount: submit enabled, server 400 silently ignored
all.why: customer-portal/page.tsx line 410 gates submit only on reason; line 143 omits amount when blank; lines 148-156 handle only res.ok. refunds/request/route.ts line 65 returns the 400.
all.fix: Disable submit until a valid partial amount is entered, and surface non-2xx errors inline.

all.summary: Refund request submission fails silently on any non-2xx or network error
all.why: customer-portal/page.tsx submitRefundRequest lines 148-159: no else branch for !res.ok and the catch only console.errors, so a rejected money-adjacent request shows the customer nothing.
all.fix: Add an inline error state for non-2xx and network failures, mirroring confirmDelivery's confirmError pattern.

all.summary: Vanished saved works render a title-cased UUID linking to a dead browse page
all.why: SaveButton callers pass work.id (UUIDs) in browse pages; saved/page.tsx lines 202-206 fall back to formatName(item_id) and /browse/{item_id}; the line 32 comment still claims slug format.
all.fix: Render a 'no longer available' row for unresolved works, drop the dead link, and correct the stale comment.

all.summary: Empty-state 'Add address' CTA links to '#' instead of opening the form
all.why: addresses/page.tsx line 305: cta href '#'. Impact is small because the working header 'Add address' button (lines 183-189) renders on the same screen.
all.fix: Give EmptyState an onClick variant, or point the CTA at startCreate like the header button.

all.summary: Demo soft-200 responses would show false success toasts; latent for customers
all.why: customer-addresses routes return 200 {demo:true}; addresses/page.tsx uses mutate, which only throws on non-2xx. demo-guard.ts reads only DEMO_ARTIST_USER_ID/DEMO_VENUE_USER_ID, so no customer id is configurable today.
all.fix: Have mutate (or the callers) check data.demo and toast a read-only notice instead of success.

all.summary: Change Password failure is silent; the button just resets
all.why: settings/page.tsx handlePasswordReset: 'if (!error) setResetSent(true)' with no else branch, so a Supabase rejection leaves no message and looks like nothing happened.
all.fix: Set an error state on failure and render it under the button.

all.summary: Customer notification-preferences card is non-functional end to end
all.why: No code inserts customer_profiles rows; preferences route PATCH is UPDATE..eq(user_id) returning ok on zero rows (its own comment says prod lacks the table entirely); messages/route.ts 768-794 reads only artist/venue prefs; email_digest_enabled has no consumer.
all.fix: Replace the card with links or controls backed by the real email_preferences system, or remove it.
all.challenge: No send path reads customer prefs, so the card controls nothing that exists; dead settings control, marketing opt-out lives in email_preferences separately.

all.summary: Hard delete destroys the auth user even when PII scrubs failed
all.why: account/delete/route.ts lines 131-136: per-table errors only console.error'd, then auth.admin.deleteUser runs regardless. The sibling account/route.ts collects failures and refuses auth deletion, the opposite policy.
all.fix: Collect scrub failures and return 500 without deleting the auth user, mirroring DELETE /api/account.
all.challenge: Harm requires a hypothetical per-table scrub error; the concrete demonstrated gap is C14. Speculative failure path, fix alongside C14.

all.summary: Self-service deletion destroys orders the soft route says must be kept for tax
all.why: account/delete/route.ts deletes orders and refund_requests rows outright; account/route.ts anonymises them citing tax/legal preservation; AccountDangerZone.tsx line 34 wires only the hard path. Contradictory legal positions, owner ruling needed.
all.fix: Owner decides retention posture; point AccountDangerZone at the surviving endpoint and align the other.
all.challenge: Rare user action at launch, database backups mitigate, and it is an owner policy ruling; not launch-gating.

all.summary: Hard delete leaves buyer name and address in email-keyed orders while claiming success
all.why: delete route's TABLES_USER_ID matches orders only by buyer_user_id; api/orders/route.ts lines 171-175 confirm all 12 live orders are email-keyed with no buyer_user_id, so erasure returns ok leaving shipping PII intact.
all.fix: Add a buyer_email-keyed anonymisation pass (buyer_email and shipping) mirroring step 4 of the soft route.
all.challenge: Erasure requests near zero at launch; GDPR allows manual fulfilment within a month and order retention has a lawful basis. Real defect is the false success claim.

all.summary: POST /api/account/delete lacks the demo guard every sibling mutation has
all.why: account/route.ts calls assertNotDemo; account/delete/route.ts imports and calls no demo guard, so a configured demo artist/venue session can hard-delete the shared demo account.
all.fix: Add assertNotDemo (or the strict 403 variant) at the top of the POST handler.
all.challenge: Public demo login lets any visitor hard-delete the shared demo auth user and seeded data; sibling mutations are guarded, this one is not.

all.summary: Soft-delete endpoint is dead code; no UI offers the anonymise option
all.why: Grep finds no caller of DELETE /api/account outside its own route and tests; AccountDangerZone posts only /api/account/delete. GET /api/account genuinely does not exist, matching the row's note.
all.fix: Fold into the C13 owner decision; wire the chosen endpoint into the UI and delete the loser.

all.summary: userSlug derived from display name is fragile message identity
all.why: messages/page.tsx line 14 derives slugify(displayName) else email local part; MessageInbox lines 481/492 send it as sender_name and line 1032 uses it as the legacy is-me fallback. sender_id remains the primary match.
all.fix: Issue a stable server-side participant identifier and stop deriving sender_name client-side.

all.summary: Refund-approved notification link and sale fallback both 404 for customers
all.why: refunds/process/route.ts line 421 stores /customer-portal/orders?id={id}; Header.tsx line 651 falls back to {portalBase}/orders. Neither route exists for customers; working target is /customer-portal?order=.
all.fix: Store /customer-portal?order={id}, fix the Header customer fallback, and add the C4 redirect as a backstop.

all.summary: Mobile 'Notifications' menu entry is a plain link to the dashboard
all.why: Header.tsx lines 982-992: the entry links {portalBase} with a bell icon and 'Notifications' label; no notifications page or mobile list exists anywhere.
all.fix: Relabel the entry, or open the notifications dropdown content in the mobile menu.

all.summary: Portal switcher's &hint= param is never read by the login page
all.why: Header.tsx line 818 appends &hint={role}; login/page.tsx line 34 reads only ?email=. With one email across role accounts the hint cannot steer sign-in.
all.fix: Drop hint from the switcher URL, or consume it to steer account selection at sign-in.

all.summary: Signed-out helper link lands on the unsubscribe failure state
all.why: account/email/page.tsx lines 98-99 link /account/email/unsubscribe with no params; the unsubscribe page (lines 57-59) renders the 'couldn't read the unsubscribe details' state without c and u.
all.fix: Unlink the sentence; keep it as plain text advising the reader to use their email's link.

all.summary: digest_frequency exists on the API contract with no control and no consumer
all.why: email-preferences route accepts daily/weekly/off (line 83) and migration 016 defaults 'weekly', but the /account/email page renders no control and send.ts never reads it.
all.fix: Drop digest_frequency from the API contract, or add the control and a digest consumer.

all.summary: Working email-preferences hub is only reachable from email footers
all.why: Grep finds /account/email linked only from src/emails templates and the inactive-users cron; no portal navigation or settings page links it, while the customer settings card (C11) is broken.
all.fix: Link /account/email from the customer settings page (and ideally artist/venue settings).

all.summary: Visible unsubscribe link in every notify/news email always fails
all.why: EmailShell.tsx builds /account/email/unsubscribe?c={category} with no u; the page (lines 57-59) requires both c and u, so the primary human unsubscribe path can never succeed. PECR/GDPR working-unsubscribe issue.
all.fix: Thread the recipient's user id (or a signed token) into EmailShell and append it to the link.

all.summary: RFC 8058 one-click POSTs hit the page URL and 405; purpose-built API unreferenced
all.why: send.ts line 229 sets List-Unsubscribe to the page path with One-Click Post enabled; App Router pages accept no POST. /api/account/email/unsubscribe has POST/GET but zero references. A mailto arm partially mitigates.
all.fix: Point the List-Unsubscribe URL at /api/account/email/unsubscribe.
all.challenge: RFC 8058 one-click is a Gmail/Yahoo bulk-sender rule (5k+/day), far beyond launch volume; mailto arm works; the legal unsubscribe gate is C24.

all.summary: Unsubscribe u param is a raw unsigned UUID; prefetchers can silently unsubscribe
all.why: unsubscribe/page.tsx lines 63-72 upsert email_preferences.{key}=false for any supplied UUID during GET render, so link scanners prefetching the URL flip preferences, and anyone knowing a UUID can too.
all.fix: Sign the link with an HMAC of user plus category and verify it before applying the change.
all.challenge: Fails safe: prefetchers can only over-unsubscribe, no PII exposed; random UUIDs are unguessable. Engagement nuisance, not a compliance or security hole.

all.summary: Unauthenticated upsert accepts arbitrary UUIDs with no FK or rate limit
all.why: Migration 016: email_preferences.user_id is 'uuid PRIMARY KEY' with no REFERENCES auth.users; neither the page nor the API route applies any rate limiting, so junk rows are unbounded.
all.fix: Verify the user exists before upserting (or require the C26 signed token) and rate limit both entry points.

all.summary: Critical-category state links 'delete your account' to nonexistent /account/delete
all.why: unsubscribe/page.tsx line 92 links /account/delete; src/app/(pages)/account contains only appeal, email, export and security, so the link 404s. The state is rarely reachable (crafted c=security links).
all.fix: Point the link at the portal settings pages, or create a small deletion landing page.

all.summary: Unsubscribe API GET comment claims a redirect but returns bare JSON
all.why: api/account/email/unsubscribe/route.ts lines 66-75: comment says 'redirect to the page-side success view', handler returns NextResponse.json. Cosmetic while nothing links the API.
all.fix: Make GET redirect to the page's success view when the C25 fix lands, or correct the comment.

all.summary: Export page POSTs an API that only exports GET, so every export 405s
all.why: account/export/page.tsx line 26 calls mutate with method POST; api/account/export/route.ts exports only GET. Every attempt lands in the error state with the privacy@ manual fallback, so self-service access is dead.
all.fix: Switch the page to a GET download link (or add a POST handler); one side must change verb.
all.challenge: Error state surfaces the privacy@ manual route; GDPR access can be fulfilled manually at launch volume. Not a dead end.

all.summary: Ready state promises an email link that no job will ever send
all.why: The route streams JSON inline with Content-Disposition and returns no downloadUrl; no export email job exists. The branch is also unreachable today because of the C30 405.
all.fix: Remove the email-promise branch and link the authenticated GET directly as the download.

all.summary: HTML entity ’ renders literally inside a JSX string expression
all.why: account/export/page.tsx line 78: "We’ll email you..." sits in a JS string inside a ternary, where entities are not decoded. Currently unreachable due to the C30 405.
all.fix: Use a real apostrophe or the JSX entity outside the string expression.

all.summary: Data export silently omits several tables and queries two nonexistent ones
all.why: export/route.ts lines 68-71 query 'applications' and 'waitlist' (real names artist_applications, waitlist_signups per the delete route) and key artist_collections.artist_id by user id (it holds artist_profiles.id, migration 005); fetchAll swallows errors; customer_addresses, email_preferences, purchase_offers, commissions and visualizer tables absent; no rate limit.
all.fix: Correct table names and keys, add the omitted tables, and rate limit the endpoint.
all.challenge: Unreachable until C30 is fixed (export never runs); manual fulfilment covers access requests meanwhile. Fix with C30.

all.summary: Security page tells readers to review recent activity, which does not exist
all.why: account/security/page.tsx line 33 says 'resetting your password and reviewing recent activity'; no session or activity surface exists anywhere, and the customer destination offers only a password reset.
all.fix: Trim the sentence to the password reset.

all.summary: Pre-confirmation terms acceptances keyed only by body email remain forgeable
all.why: All signup callers (signup/customer, artist, venue, ApplicationForm) POST /api/terms/accept unauthenticated with a body email before confirmation. Documented residual awaiting an owner decision on when evidence is stamped.
all.fix: Record acceptance post-confirmation from the verified token; keep it on the owner's launch list meanwhile.

all.summary: No mechanism prompts existing users to re-accept revised terms
all.why: termsVersion 'v1.0-2026-04' is hard-coded in the four signup callers; nothing compares accepted versions to a current version, and /api/terms/accept has no other call sites.
all.fix: Record as a follow-up: a version-check gate prompting re-acceptance when the terms version bumps.

all.summary: Trial-copy gate promises free trial to the one audience charged immediately
all.why: PortalGuard.tsx:96-143 shows the gate only for past_due/canceled, and subscribe/route.ts:84-85 sets trialDays=0 for exactly those statuses, so the promise is false for every viewer.
all.fix: Swap the gate copy for reactivating users to state billing restarts immediately, no trial.
all.challenge: Gate audience is past_due/canceled only, an empty set at launch; Stripe checkout shows the real charge before payment. Fix before first cancellations, weeks away.

all.summary: Payouts checklist ticks when Stripe onboarding has merely started
all.why: artist-portal/page.tsx:142 ticks on stripe_connect_account_id; stripe-connect/onboard/route.ts:59-99 stores that id before redirecting to Stripe; status/route.ts:37 exposes the real onboardingComplete billing already uses.
all.fix: Drive the checklist tick from /api/stripe-connect/status onboardingComplete instead of account-id presence.

all.summary: "Enquiries This Month" tile shows an all-time count
all.why: artist-portal/page.tsx:412 labels the tile "This Month"; api/dashboard/route.ts:107 calls artistTotals, and lib/analytics/artist-totals.ts counts enquiries with no date window.
all.fix: Relabel the tile "Total Enquiries", or pass a month window into the count.

all.summary: Refund and notification deep links to orders?id= select nothing
all.why: orders/page.tsx has no useSearchParams (grep confirms), while artist-portal/page.tsx:191,221 and refunds/process/route.ts:485, refunds/request/route.ts:218 all mint ?id= links.
all.fix: Read the id query param in orders/page.tsx and preselect that order on load.

all.summary: Quick Action "Update Availability" opens Placements, not where availability lives
all.why: artist-portal/page.tsx:479 links the label to /artist-portal/placements; work availability is edited on portfolio/page.tsx (bulkSetAvailability, per-work available toggles).
all.fix: Point the link at /artist-portal/portfolio or rename it "View Placements".

all.summary: Earnings chart is fixed last-7-months but captioned with the selected range
all.why: analytics/page.tsx:139-157 builds earningsData over a hard-coded 7-month loop from an unfiltered /api/orders fetch, while line 368 prints {dateRange} beside "Earnings Over Time".
all.fix: Remove the {dateRange} caption from that card, or filter orders to the range.

all.summary: Analytics placements table badges compare title-case against lower-case statuses
all.why: analytics/page.tsx:82 keeps raw p.status (lower-case), lines 414-416 compare to "Active"/"Sold"/"Pending", so every badge hits the grey default; lines 111-115 fixed the counts case-insensitively but not the badges.
all.fix: Normalise status case before comparing, matching the counts fix on the same page.

all.summary: Locked feed tab labelled "(Pro)" though any paid plan unlocks it
all.why: artwork-requests/page.tsx:40 gates on sub.active, which lib/subscriptions.ts:33 derives from status alone (plan-agnostic), yet line 107 annotates the tab "(Pro)".
all.fix: Change the annotation to "(Paid)" or drop it; UpgradePrompt copy is already right.

all.summary: Referral panel is dead code and redemption is unwired
all.why: Panel part is real: billing/page.tsx:120-133 fetchSub never copies referral_code, so line 382 never renders. But redemption IS wired: webhooks/stripe/route.ts:1331-1346 credits 30 days via extend_free_until.
all.fix: Copy referral_code through fetchSub state; redemption already works in the webhook.

all.summary: Plan-picker footer promises first month free to reactivating users
all.why: billing/page.tsx:285 hides the picker only for active/trialing, so canceled/past_due see line 444's promise, while subscribe/route.ts:84-85 gives them trialDays=0.
all.fix: Hide or reword the first-month-free footer when subscription_status is canceled or past_due.
all.challenge: Same empty-at-launch audience as D1; nobody is canceled or past_due on day one, and Stripe displays the actual amount due.

all.summary: "Prorated automatically" copy vs replace-then-cancel checkout mechanism
all.why: subscribe/route.ts:95 starts a new Checkout with cancel_previous metadata, but webhooks/stripe/route.ts:1208 cancels the old sub with prorate:true, so unused time is credited; the switcher still pays full upfront with credit landing later.
all.fix: Reword to "unused time on your old plan is credited to your next invoice".

all.summary: Pro "Unlimited works" contradicts hard 50 cap; Core bullets disagree across surfaces
all.why: artist-works/route.ts:94 caps pro at 50 with a 403, while billing/page.tsx:485 and ArtistPricingCards.tsx:57 say unlimited; ArtistPricingCards.tsx:27 gives Core "Message venues directly", billing's Core bullets omit it.
all.fix: Say "Up to 50 works" everywhere and reconcile the Core messaging bullet between surfaces.

all.summary: Demo subscribe shows generic "Failed to start checkout" instead of demo message
all.why: subscribe/route.ts:22 soft-guards (200 {demo:true}, no url); billing/page.tsx:194-200 checks only data.url and toasts the generic error, never reading data.demo.
all.fix: Check data.demo in handleSubscribe and toast the guard's own message.

all.summary: Blog DELETE API exists but no delete button anywhere in artist UI
all.why: api/blogs/[id]/route.ts:246 implements owner DELETE; grep finds no delete affordance in blogs/page.tsx or BlogEditor.tsx.
all.fix: Add a delete action to the blog list rows, or accept the gap for launch.

all.summary: Collections publish live with no subscription gate, unlike works
all.why: artist-works/route.ts:77-86 402-gates available=true under GATING_V1; collections/route.ts POST/PATCH has no gate (only demo guard), and collections/[id]/route.ts:39 serves any available=true row publicly.
all.fix: Apply the same GATING_V1 402 check to collections POST/PATCH when available is true.
all.challenge: GATING_V1 prodDefault is true (feature-flags.ts:74), so the paid publish gate is live while collections publish publicly ungated: a full paywall bypass.

all.summary: Labels page never sets venueSlug, breaking venue QR revenue-share attribution
all.why: labels/page.tsx:161-199 sets only venueName (names fetched at 110-118); LabelSheet.tsx:83 emits vs only from venueSlug; qr/[slug]/route.ts resolves venue_user_id, redirect venue param and signed va only from vs, so venue share silently zeroes.
all.fix: Thread venue_slug from /api/placements through the dropdown, buildLabels, and the placements deep link.

all.summary: "Required for £100+ orders" tracking rule is enforced nowhere
all.why: orders/page.tsx:245 shows the copy; line 88 sends trackingNumber only if entered, and api/orders/route.ts:223 applies it conditionally with no value-based requirement on shipped.
all.fix: Soften the helper text to a recommendation, or block shipped over £100 without tracking.

all.summary: Refund approve/reject fails silently on any non-2xx response
all.why: orders/page.tsx:125-145 updates state only if res.ok; api-client.ts authFetch never throws on non-2xx, so 403/409/500 produce no toast, no inline error, nothing.
all.fix: Handle non-ok responses in processRefund with a toast carrying the server's error message.

all.summary: "Issue Refund" always 403s on self-approve yet UI closes as if refunded
all.why: orders/page.tsx:147-177 chains request then process; refunds/process/route.ts:93-94 403s artist-raised requests without admin, and the client closes the form unconditionally, adding nothing to the list, saying nothing.
all.fix: Rename to "Request refund", skip the doomed approve call, and show a queued-for-admin state.

all.summary: Pro client limit 9999 vs API cap 50; no at-limit UI at 50
all.why: portfolio/page.tsx:204 sets PORTFOLIO_LIMITS.pro=9999 while artist-works/route.ts:94 caps at 50, so the client never enters at-limit state; the 51st save surfaces only the API's 403 message via mutate.
all.fix: Set PORTFOLIO_LIMITS.pro to 50 and align the "Unlimited works" marketing strings.

all.summary: Oversized primary image upload leaves button stuck on "Uploading..."
all.why: portfolio/page.tsx:1608 awaits uploadImage with no try/catch; lib/upload.ts:104-109 throws on bad type or >10MB, so setUploading(false) at 1618 never runs; the additional-images path (1644-1656) has the try/catch.
all.fix: Wrap handleImageFile's upload in try/catch/finally, setting formError and resetting uploading; same for profile photo.
all.challenge: Stuck button, recoverable with a refresh and re-upload; artist-side only, no data loss. Confusing UX with a workaround.

all.summary: Saving without an image publishes a picsum stock photo as the artwork
all.why: portfolio/page.tsx:1822 falls back to https://picsum.photos/seed/new-work/900/600; the submit validation (title, priced size) never checks imagePreview, so imageless works go available on public browse.
all.fix: Require an image before save, or force imageless works to available=false drafts.

all.summary: Five bulk portfolio paths toast success before the server confirms
all.why: portfolio/page.tsx:534-537 saveWorks is fire-and-forget (errors console-only); bulkSetAvailability (589), bulk add (1035), bulk prices (1143), copy-from apply (1370) and reorder (559) all toast immediately; in-code E41-e acknowledges it.
all.fix: Migrate the five saveWorks callers onto the awaited postWorks/save-control path like single add/delete.

all.summary: Bulk add silently discards incomplete drafts when any draft is valid
all.why: portfolio/page.tsx:950-962 filters to valid drafts and errors only when none are valid; after saving, setBulkAddDrafts([]) discards the rest with only "Added N works" shown.
all.fix: Keep invalid drafts in the modal with per-draft errors instead of clearing them.
all.challenge: Bulk add silently discards typed titles and uploaded images of incomplete drafts whenever any draft is valid; the rubric's silent-input-discard class.

all.summary: "Now showing at" matches placements of any status, ignored status param
all.why: posts/page.tsx:26 requests ?status=active but placements/route.ts:150 reads only archived; the find at posts/page.tsx:45-47 matches on title alone, so pending/declined/completed placements yield the banner.
all.fix: Filter client-side to placements with status active before matching titles.

all.summary: Revenue share percent has no upper bound client or server side
all.why: profile/page.tsx:912-916 has min=0 only; revenue_share_percent sits on ARTIST_PROFILE_WRITABLE (writable-fields.ts:51) with no clamp in artist-profile/route.ts, and placements/route.ts:502 carries it into placement terms unclamped.
all.fix: Clamp 0-100 in the input (max attr) and in the artist-profile PUT route.
all.challenge: Needs self-inflicted invalid input by the artist; terms are visible to the counterparty before acceptance; clamp is a trivial post-launch fix.

all.summary: Unresolved saved works link to /browse/{workId}, which cannot resolve
all.why: saved/page.tsx:44-47 returns /browse/${itemId} for type "work" where itemId is a work id; the /browse/[slug] route expects an artist slug, so the fallback link dead-ends.
all.fix: Render unmatched saved works unlinked with their saved date, as the title fallback already does.

all.summary: "Current password" field is collected but never read or verified
all.why: settings/page.tsx:64-90 validates only newPassword/confirm and calls supabase.auth.updateUser({password}) at line 79; currentPassword is only cleared at line 86, never checked.
all.fix: Verify via signInWithPassword before updating, or remove the decorative field.

all.summary: Demo sessions see ordinary success toasts for writes that never happened
all.why: Grep finds no data.demo consumer across src/app/(pages)/artist-portal; demo-guard.ts soft guard returns 200 {demo:true}, so optimistic toasts stand; only strict-guarded stripe-connect routes (403) surface it.
all.fix: Check the demo flag centrally in mutate()/useSaveAction and toast the guard's message once.

all.summary: /venue-portal/enquiries reachable from dashboard but absent from sidebar nav
all.why: src/components/VenuePortalLayout.tsx lines 11-25 list every nav item; no enquiries entry. Dashboard page.tsx line 383 links to it. The page itself is dead (see E27).
all.fix: Remove the page and the dashboard Quick Action rather than adding a nav entry.

all.summary: Venue dashboard Total Spent sums customer QR sales as venue spending
all.why: src/app/api/dashboard/route.ts line 132 matches orders by venue_slug OR buyer_email; venue-portal/page.tsx line 111 sums o.total over all rows, so placement sales inflate Total Spent.
all.fix: Sum only buyer_email-matched orders, mirroring the Orders page classification.

all.summary: Any sent message completes Send your first enquiry checklist item
all.why: dashboard/route.ts line 133 counts all messages with sender_name = slug; venue-portal/page.tsx line 144 uses sentMessageCount > 0 and links to /browse. Replies count too.
all.fix: Accept as-is, or relabel to Message an artist and keep the loose counter.

all.summary: Set up payouts ticks when Stripe account row exists, before onboarding completes
all.why: stripe-connect/onboard/route.ts line 99 stores the account id at creation; venue-portal/page.tsx line 145 keys completion on stripe_connect_account_id truthiness, while status uses charges_enabled and details_submitted.
all.fix: Key completion on the stripe-connect status endpoint's complete flag instead of the raw id.

all.summary: Dashboard View Enquiries quick action funnels venues to a permanently empty page
all.why: venue-portal/page.tsx line 383 links to /venue-portal/enquiries; src/app/api/enquiry/route.ts exports only POST, so the page's GET always fails and the list is empty forever.
all.fix: Point the quick action at /venue-portal/messages and delete the enquiries page.
all.challenge: No producer of venue-directed enquiries exists, so the empty page misses nothing real; a plausible empty state, not lost data.

all.summary: Profile section Cancel hides inputs but keeps edits; next Save persists them
all.why: venue-portal/profile/page.tsx lines 423 and 656: Cancel only calls setEditing(null); detail*/display* state and the dirty flag are untouched, and handleSave always sends them.
all.fix: On Cancel, reset the section's state from the loaded venue record.

all.summary: interested_in_collections never editable in portal while /spaces filters read it
all.why: No control on profile/page.tsx and none in the save payload, true. But spaces/page.tsx filters only on free-loan/revenue/purchase; nothing user-facing reads interestedInCollections, only /api/venues/demand serves it.
all.fix: Add a toggle alongside the other interest switches, or drop the field from the demand payload.

all.summary: Empty profiles pre-select fabricated styles and themes that Save silently persists
all.why: profile/page.tsx lines 251-252 default styles to Contemporary/Minimal/Photography and themes to Nature/City/Architecture when the row is empty; handleSave sends them, so artists target venues on invented preferences.
all.fix: Initialise styles and themes to empty arrays when the saved row has none.
all.challenge: Defaults are editable and only degrade matching quality; wrong-but-harmless data, no money or destruction involved.

all.summary: Preferred Artwork Sizes pills are decorative; selection never saved
all.why: profile/page.tsx line 253 hardcodes sizes to Medium+Large on every load; the handleSave payload has no sizes key, and writable-fields.ts documents preferred_sizes as vestigial, existing in no schema.
all.fix: Remove the sizes control until a preferred_sizes column exists.

all.summary: Venue cannot edit contact name, phone or address anywhere in the portal
all.why: VENUE_PROFILE_WRITABLE in src/lib/db/writable-fields.ts allows contact_name, email, phone, address fields, but profile/page.tsx exposes no inputs for any of them and Settings' fields are dead (E12).
all.fix: Add a Contact Details section on the profile page wired to the already-allowlisted columns.

all.summary: Demo venue sees false Saved confirmation for writes that never landed
all.why: api/venue-profile/route.ts returns 200 {demo:true} via assertNotDemo; profile/page.tsx handleSave ignores the response body and sets saved=true unconditionally.
all.fix: Check data.demo in handleSave and show the demo toast instead of Saved.

all.summary: Settings account fields are a dead form; typed input silently discarded
all.why: venue-portal/settings/page.tsx: Field renders an uncontrolled input with defaultValue only (lines 33-54); no onChange, no save button, no submit handler anywhere in the section.
all.fix: Render the three values read-only with an edit link to the profile page.
all.challenge: With no save button the form never claims persistence, so nothing lies to the user; display-only settings section.

all.summary: Preferences GET 500s for every venue; checkboxes always show defaults
all.why: api/account/preferences/route.ts selects all three PREF_FIELDS from venue_profiles; tests/integration/schema-columns.json confirms venue_profiles lacks order_notifications_enabled, so the SELECT errors and useNotificationPrefs swallows it, showing opt-in defaults.
all.fix: Use a per-role field list, selecting only columns that exist on venue_profiles.
all.challenge: Checkboxes show defaults for transactional notification toggles; no marketing or legal exposure, cosmetic wrong state.

all.summary: Order updates toggle PATCHes a missing column and fails every time
all.why: use-notification-prefs.ts PATCHes {order_notifications_enabled}; the venue_profiles update hits the non-existent column, 500s, and the checkbox reverts with Could not save preference.
all.fix: Hide the Order updates row for venues, or add the column via migration.

all.summary: Digest checkbox writes a column the email send path never reads
all.why: src/lib/email/send.ts line 112 consults only email_preferences for opt-outs; venue_profiles.email_digest_enabled is written by settings but read by nothing, so the checkbox cannot stop the weekly digest.
all.fix: Back the checkbox with email_preferences.digests_enabled, or remove it and link the email-preferences page.
all.challenge: One weekly digest; harm requires the digest actually sending and a venue trying to opt out; fix rides the email-preferences work.

all.summary: Expanded placement row shows venue's cut as percent to artist
all.why: venue-portal/placements/page.tsx line 1533 renders {pct}% to artist; src/lib/payouts/legs.ts lines 173-174 compute venueCutPence from the same revenue_share_percent, and the request form (line 1037) says % to the venue.
all.fix: Change the label to % to your venue on sales.
all.challenge: Display label only on the expanded row; the request form and payout maths agree, so no money moves wrongly. Copy fix.

all.summary: Per-placement QR scan counts exclude modern-label scans; near-guaranteed zero
all.why: api/placements/route.ts lines 225-232 compare event work_id (a UUID from qr/[slug]/route.ts line 74) with work TITLE, and venue_name (display name, line 62) with venue_slug; both predicates reject modern events.
all.fix: Reuse the analytics endpoint's venue_user_id plus work_id attribution for the per-placement count.

all.summary: Mobile placement card hardcodes QR Scans to literal 0
all.why: venue-portal/placements/page.tsx line 1869 renders a literal 0 in the mobile expanded card while the desktop cell at line 1562 renders p.qrScans.
all.fix: Render p.qrScans ?? 0 like the desktop cell.

all.summary: Mobile Loan record button is byte-identical to Open full placement
all.why: placements/page.tsx lines 1962 and 1969 both link to /placements/{id}; the ?record=open param that PlacementDetailClient.tsx line 151 reads is only appended on the desktop link (line 1692).
all.fix: Append ?record=open to the mobile Loan record link.

all.summary: Request form claims paid-loan billing is manual; billing is automated
all.why: placements/page.tsx line 1007 says Billing is handled manually for now, yet the same page renders PaidLoanPaymentChip driving Stripe subscription setup at /placements/[id]/payment, which exists.
all.fix: Rewrite the helper text to say billing is set up after installation via Stripe.

all.summary: Optimistic placement insert uses fake p- id whose links 404 until refresh
all.why: placements/page.tsx line 640 generates p-{Date.now()} locally after POST and never reads the server id, so the row's Open/QR-label links target /placements/p-... which does not exist.
all.fix: Use the id the API returns, or reload the list after a confirmed submit.

all.summary: Min-only budgets render as nonsense £300 to £0
all.why: venue-portal/artwork-requests/page.tsx line 150 renders £{min||0} to £{max||0}, so a request with only budget_min_pence shows an upper bound of £0.
all.fix: Render open-ended bounds as from £300 or up to £500.

all.summary: Artwork-request share field uses opposite direction to placements' venue-cut semantics
all.why: ArtworkRequestForm.tsx lines 235-248 label the share as paid to the artist; accepting a placement response (responses/[responseId]/route.ts line 182) writes it into placements.revenue_share_percent, which payouts/legs.ts treats as the venue's cut.
all.fix: Standardise on the venue-cut direction platform-wide and relabel this field to match.

all.summary: Accepting a commission response navigates the venue straight to a 404
all.why: responses/[responseId]/route.ts line 121 sets nextStepLink to /venue-portal/commissions and line 250 to /artist-portal/commissions; neither directory exists under src/app/(pages), and the detail page window.location.href's it on accept.
all.fix: Retarget nextStepLink to the request detail page until a commissions surface exists.

all.summary: View commission link on accepted responses points at a nonexistent route
all.why: venue-portal/artwork-requests/[id]/page.tsx line 319 links linked_commission_id rows to /venue-portal/commissions, which has no page; same root cause as E24.
all.fix: Point the link at the request detail or remove it until the route ships.
all.challenge: Secondary link with the same root cause as E24 (kept P1); one fix covers both.

all.summary: Mark fulfilled on linked responses can only ever return 409
all.why: fulfill/route.ts lines 117-120 reject any response carrying a linked_* id with 409; accept writes those ids (responses route lines 231-233), and the detail page shows the button on every accepted response.
all.fix: Hide the per-response button when a linked_* id exists; header Mark fulfilled covers the flip.

all.summary: Enquiries page fetches a GET that does not exist; permanently empty list
all.why: venue-portal/enquiries/page.tsx fetches GET /api/enquiry; src/app/api/enquiry/route.ts exports only POST, so the fetch 405s, .catch swallows it, and every venue sees the empty state forever.
all.fix: Delete the page and its dashboard entry point; the Messages inbox covers the job.
all.challenge: Same as E5: no venue-directed enquiries are ever created, so the permanently empty list loses nothing.

all.summary: Enquiries status tabs use a capitalised union the DB never stores
all.why: enquiries/page.tsx types Status as Pending/Responded/Closed while api/enquiry/route.ts inserts lowercase pending; the cast at mapping would keep the raw value, so filters and badge lookup would miss. Moot on a dead fetch.
all.fix: Dies with the page removal; no separate fix needed.

all.summary: Enquiries data model has no venue scoping even server-side
all.why: enquiries rows (api/enquiry/route.ts insert) carry sender_name/sender_email/artist_slug only; nothing links them to a venue account, so a working GET would need a from-scratch design. Concept belongs to Messages.
all.fix: Remove the page; do not build a venue-scoped GET.

all.summary: Messages shell spins forever when the venue profile never resolves
all.why: venue-portal/messages/page.tsx renders Loading messages... while loading || !venue?.slug; useCurrentVenue.ts sets venue null with loading false when the API has no row and the static fallback misses, so the shell never advances.
all.fix: When loading is false and venue is null, render the self-heal failure banner with Retry.

all.summary: Saved works tab silently drops works saved from the live database
all.why: venue-portal/saved/page.tsx resolves saved ids against getGalleryWorks(), which src/data/galleries.ts builds from static seed artists only; DB UUIDs find no match and are filtered out, while /api/walls/saved-works resolves them fine.
all.fix: Resolve the works tab through /api/walls/saved-works like the wall visualiser does.
all.challenge: Saves persist and render correctly in the wall visualizer via /api/walls/saved-works; display filter bug on one tab, no data loss.

all.summary: LabelPreview per-label size selector is dead for venues
all.why: venue-portal/labels/page.tsx line 560 passes availableSizes={[]}; LabelPreview.tsx line 187 maps over it so no options render, whereas artist-portal/labels/page.tsx line 544 passes real sizes.
all.fix: Pass the work's pricing labels, or hide the size block when the list is empty.

all.summary: Analytics API computes scans_over_time and placement_revenue the page never renders
all.why: api/analytics/venue/route.ts returns scans_over_time, placement_revenue and placement_revenue_total (lines 158-162); venue-portal/analytics/page.tsx declares scans_over_time in its interface and renders neither.
all.fix: Chart the time series, or strip the unused fields from this endpoint's response.

all.summary: Layout-creation failure after wall create silently dumps user on the list
all.why: venue-portal/walls/new/page.tsx lines 233-238: the comment says surface the issue but the code only router.replace's to the list with no message. Recoverable, the editor self-creates a layout on open.
all.fix: Show a toast explaining the wall was created but its layout needs reopening.

all.summary: Wall colour edits on saved preset walls are never persisted
all.why: WallVisualizer.tsx saveLayout (lines 213-278) PATCHes only dims and items, never wall_color_hex, though api/walls/[id]/route.ts line 117 accepts it; the config bar keeps the colour controls enabled, so recolours vanish on reload.
all.fix: Include wall_color_hex in the wall PATCH when the background colour changed.

all.summary: Curated hero asset contradicts its own gallery-interior comment; alt says Patagonia
all.why: CuratedClient.tsx line 285 uses /images/auth-bg.jpg, which I inspected: it genuinely is Mt. Fitz Roy, so the alt is accurate and the comment/asset choice is what is wrong, inverting the flag's suggested fix.
all.fix: Swap in an actual gallery-interior asset and update the alt to match.

all.summary: Curation submissions from signed-in venues are stored anonymous
all.why: CuratedClient.tsx line 217 submits via plain fetch with only Content-Type; api/curation/route.ts lines 103-108 resolve requester_user_id solely from a bearer token, so it is always null.
all.fix: Use authFetch when a session exists so requester_user_id is captured.

all.summary: Every tier detail footer promises cancel any time, including one-off payments
all.why: curated/[tier]/page.tsx line 136 renders {priceLabel} · cancel any time. unconditionally; Single wall, Full space and Bespoke are one-off or quoted, where the real promise is refund-if-nothing-fits.
all.fix: Show cancel any time only for the managed subscription tiers.
all.challenge: 'Cancel any time' printed under one-off and quoted tiers is a false term of sale on a purchase decision surface; refund-expectation liability.

all.summary: Venue empty-state copy invites messaging with no compose control in the inbox
all.why: MessageInbox.tsx:855 renders the copy; compose only opens via initialArtistSlug prop (line 303-315). No compose button exists anywhere in the inbox.
all.fix: Link the venue empty state to /browse so the CTA is actionable.

all.summary: Hover-X delete hard-deletes both parties' copies; confirm gives no warning
all.why: MessageInbox.tsx:788 confirm has no body copy; api/messages/[conversationId]/route.ts DELETE removes every row for the conversation, destroying the counterparty's thread and the placement_request trail requester inference relies on.
all.fix: Implement per-user archiving (hidden flags) or warn explicitly that both parties lose the thread.

all.summary: Unread count checks artist profile first, ignores dual-role user's venue slug
all.why: api/messages/unread/route.ts returns early on the artist slug; mark-read paths (messages/[conversationId] PATCH, messages PATCH) handle both slugs via assertConversationParticipant, so counts disagree.
all.fix: Count unread across both slugs like the mark-read paths do.

all.summary: Reply field is single-line input; Shift+Enter newline impossible, multi-line messages impossible
all.why: MessageInbox.tsx:1540 and :913 use <input type="text"> with Enter-to-send; Shift+Enter cannot insert a newline in a single-line input despite the documented behaviour.
all.fix: Swap the reply input for an auto-growing textarea keeping Enter-to-send.
