all.summary: Unknown-recipient 404 copy invites a 'reply' no channel can carry
all.why: api/messages/route.ts:334 returns 'reply with their email and we'll send them an onboarding link' inside a 404 error where the message never sent and nothing ingests replies.
all.fix: Reword the 404 to point at /contact or an invite form.

all.summary: Attachment-only sends always fail with 'Message too short'
all.why: api/messages/route.ts:276 allows empty content with attachments, then line 281 unconditionally runs moderateMessage; lib/moderation.ts rejects trimmed length <2. UI (MessageInbox.tsx:1541) enables Send with attachments only.
all.fix: Skip the length guard when attachments exist; add client-side minimum-length hint.
all.challenge: Visible 'Message too short' error with a trivial workaround: type a word. Not silent, not a dead surface.

all.summary: Message email links venues into artist portal, never auto-opens thread, subject uses raw slug
all.why: lib/email/notifications.ts:53,58 hard-codes /artist-portal/messages?c= and subject `${senderName} sent you a message` where senderName is resolvedSenderSlug; no page reads ?c= (only unsubscribe uses 'c').
all.fix: Resolve portal per recipient role, pass display name, and honour ?c= to preselect the thread.

all.summary: Outreach cap counts replies into existing threads as new contacts, blocking genuine outreach
all.why: lib/outreach-cap.ts builds conversationsToday from every conversation the artist sent any message into today; used includes replies to venue-initiated/old threads, exemption only covers the current thread.
all.fix: Count only conversations the artist initiated today, exempting all replies as documented.
all.challenge: Replies within the open thread are exempt; the cap only mis-bites artists active in 5+ distinct threads in one day, rare at launch volume.

all.summary: placement_response via POST /api/messages always emails the artist, never the venue responder case
all.why: api/messages/route.ts:718-758 sends accepted/declined templates to placement.artist_user_id regardless of responder; no client sends placement_response through this endpoint (MessageInbox uses PATCH /api/placements), so blast radius is nil today.
all.fix: Email the counterparty of the responder, mirroring the placements PATCH logic.

all.summary: Pinned bar comment claims click-to-scroll; no scroll handler exists
all.why: MessageInbox.tsx:1003 comment says 'Click to scroll'; the bar div (1009-1025) has no onClick beyond the unpin X.
all.fix: Add scroll-to-message on bar click or delete the comment.

all.summary: Help copy promises new tab; Link navigates same-tab, losing the thread
all.why: MessageInbox.tsx:1662-1668, Link href=/faqs with copy 'Open the FAQ in a new tab.' and no target=_blank.
all.fix: Add target="_blank" rel="noopener" or reword the copy.

all.summary: Report uses window.prompt inside the options modal; suppressed in some browsers
all.why: MessageInbox.tsx:1676 calls prompt() for the reason; in-app browsers that suppress prompt() make Report silently return (null reason aborts).
all.fix: Replace prompt with a textarea step inside the existing modal.

all.summary: Modal 'archive' claims restorable; actually the call 405s, archive never works at all
all.why: MessageInbox.tsx:1714 sends DELETE to /api/messages, which exports no DELETE handler, so it 405s and only the error toast shows; the flag's claimed hard-delete happens only via the hover-X path.
all.fix: Point the modal at a real per-user archive endpoint and drop the 'restored by support' copy.

all.summary: Blocks enforced only in /api/messages; offers and placements writers bypass them
all.why: user_blocks consulted only in api/messages/route.ts (lines 162, 363); api/offers/route.ts:459 and the many message inserts in api/placements/route.ts never check blocks, so blocked users still trigger cards, bells, and emails.
all.fix: Add the block check before message inserts and notifications in offers and placements routes.
all.challenge: Block usage is near zero at launch and the primary contact vector (messages) is enforced; ancillary bypass harm is speculative.

all.summary: Customer portal Messages invents a client-side slug; API 403s, inbox permanently empty
all.why: customer-portal/messages/page.tsx slugifies displayName/email; api/messages GET verifies slug against artist/venue profiles and 403s; MessageInbox swallows the failure into 'No conversations yet'.
all.fix: Give customers a server-side messaging identity, or remove the nav item and route to /contact.

all.summary: Customer sends 403 with 'complete your artist or venue profile' copy
all.why: api/messages/route.ts:312-317 rejects senders without artist/venue profiles; every customer send fails with copy meaningless to customers.
all.fix: Support a customer sender identity or return customer-appropriate copy routing to /contact.
all.challenge: Error copy on a surface already dead per F15 (kept P1); becomes moot when that surface is fixed or removed.

all.summary: Logged-out Message CTA funnels signups into the dead customer messaging surface
all.why: MessageArtistButton.tsx:56-57 pushes /signup/customer?next=/customer-portal/messages?artist=..., whose compose send is guaranteed to 403 (F15/F16).
all.fix: Route logged-out shoppers to /contact?artist=<slug> like the logged-in customer path.

all.summary: MessageInbox reads any load failure as friendly empty state, hiding hard errors
all.why: MessageInbox.tsx:268-282 checks only data.conversations; a 403/500 leaves the list empty with 'No conversations yet' and no error UI.
all.fix: Detect non-2xx in loadConversations and render an error state with retry.

all.summary: Ungated enquiry modal collects name/email but the send 401s/403s for its audience
all.why: ArtistProfileClient.tsx:1152 posts primary to /api/messages, which requires auth plus artist/venue profile; /api/enquiry (the public path) only fires after the primary succeeds, so anonymous enquiries never land anywhere.
all.fix: Make /api/enquiry the primary for anonymous/customer senders; keep /api/messages for profiled users.

all.summary: 'They typically respond within 48 hours' is an invented, unmeasured SLA
all.why: ArtistProfileClient.tsx:1123; nothing measures or enforces artist response time anywhere in the codebase.
all.fix: Soften to 'We'll let you know when they reply' or similar.

all.summary: Legacy request cards without placementId: Accept/Decline click silently does nothing
all.why: MessageInbox.tsx:642-683 skips the PATCH when metadata.placementId is absent and just refreshes; buttons still render (line 1349-1365), so the click produces no state change, message, or error.
all.fix: Disable the buttons with an explanatory tooltip when placementId is missing.

all.summary: Cancelled pill reuses declined red styling; distinct icon only, self-described nitpick
all.why: MessageInbox.tsx:1392-1399, wrapper class is accepted?green:red while cancelled gets its own icon branch; the flag itself concludes 'treat as Yes'.
all.fix: Optionally give cancelled a neutral grey style; otherwise accept as-is.

all.summary: Artist accepting a venue offer fires a doomed checkout call, 403 swallowed
all.why: MessageInbox.tsx:629 tests recipientUserId===user.id, not buyer; offers/[id]/checkout/route.ts:45 403s 'Only the buyer can check out' and the catch falls through to refresh.
all.fix: Gate the checkout call on the viewer being the offer's buyer.

all.summary: canRespond reads requester_user_id the list API never emits; panel respond buttons never show
all.why: placements GET (route.ts:289-304) emits resolved proposed_by_user_id only; schema-columns.json has no requester_user_id; placement-permissions.ts canRespond refuses when the field is missing, so PlacementContextPanel and both portal lists never show Accept/Counter/Decline.
all.fix: Emit requester_user_id (resolved requester) alongside proposed_by_user_id in the list API.
all.challenge: Verified: /placements/[id] API infers requester_user_id and the detail page renders working Accept/Counter/Decline; lists link straight to it. One-click workaround.

all.summary: Sent/Received direction tag never renders from list-API consumers
all.why: PlacementDirectionTag.tsx:71 returns null without requester_user_id, which GET /api/placements never provides (same root as F24).
all.fix: Same one-line API fix as F24 restores the tag everywhere.

all.summary: Declined state shows requester the decliner's copy and hides the Counter re-open
all.why: PlacementContextPanel.tsx:756 iAmRequester is always false without requester_user_id, so the requester reads 'You declined, the other party can come back' and never sees Counter.
all.fix: Fixed by the F24 API field mapping.

all.summary: Panel counter derives free_loan for paid loans; dialog sends paid_loan; neither sends mixed
all.why: PlacementContextPanel.tsx:381-385 maps counterPaidLoan to 'free_loan' (comment claims it's the DB value); CounterPlacementDialog.tsx:73-77 sends 'paid_loan'; PATCH stores the raw client string (route.ts:1009).
all.fix: Call deriveArrangementType client-side or drop arrangementType and derive server-side.

all.summary: Stage-advance errors swallowed; button appears to do nothing on a 422
all.why: PlacementDetailClient.tsx:296 catch { /* ignore; next load will reconcile */ } after the PATCH; the undo path toasts, the advance path does not.
all.fix: Show an error toast in the catch, matching the undo path.

all.summary: Detail-page requester chain never reads proposed_by_user_id; message scan capped at 50 platform-wide
all.why: placements/[id]/route.ts:78 reads phantom placement.requester_user_id (always undefined); fallback scans latest 50 placement_request messages platform-wide (line 86) before filtering; unresolvable rows leave both parties on 'Awaiting their response'.
all.fix: Read proposed_by_user_id and filter the message query by metadata placementId.

all.summary: Background-sync toast prints raw lowercase DB statuses
all.why: PlacementDetailClient.tsx:241 interpolates prev.status and next.status directly into the toast, bypassing the display normaliser used by every badge.
all.fix: Pass both statuses through the display-label normaliser.

all.summary: Requester-inference message scans use platform-wide caps that stop covering older placements
all.why: placements/route.ts:254 limit(1000) and route.ts:920/[id]/route.ts:86 limit(50) fetch platform-wide before client-side placementId filtering; coverage silently shrinks with volume.
all.fix: Filter metadata->>placementId server-side per placement in each query.

all.summary: Counter PATCH stores client arrangementType verbatim; schema allows 100% share vs UI's 50
all.why: placements/route.ts:1009 writes counter.arrangementType directly (deriveArrangementType used only at POST line 499); validations.ts counter schema allows revenueSharePercent max 100 while all UIs cap 50.
all.fix: Re-derive arrangement_type from fee/QR/share in the counter path; cap share at 50.

all.summary: Artist told 'we've nudged the venue' but no nudge mechanism exists
all.why: PaidLoanPaymentChip.tsx:104,107 makes the claim; src/app/api/cron has no paid-loan nudge and no other code notifies venues about unstarted billing.
all.fix: Reword the copy honestly, or add the venue nudge notification.

all.summary: Payment page headline shows artist slug: 'Pay maya-chen monthly'
all.why: placements/[id]/payment/page.tsx:64 passes placement.artist_slug || placement.artist_name; schema-columns.json confirms no artist_name column, so the slug always wins.
all.fix: Fetch the artist profile name for the payment summary.

all.summary: 'Charged at the start of each month' misstates the Stripe anniversary anchor
all.why: PaymentClient.tsx:52-54 makes the claim; payment/setup/route.ts creates a subscription Checkout session with no billing_cycle_anchor, so charges land on the signup anniversary.
all.fix: Reword to 'each month from your setup date', or anchor billing to month start.

all.summary: 'Internal notes' label on a shared record both parties read and edit
all.why: PlacementLoanForm.tsx:616; the loan record is one shared placement_records row returned to both parties by placements/[id]/route.ts, with no per-side scoping.
all.fix: Rename to 'Shared notes' or scope the field per party.

all.summary: Photo caption is API-supported and rendered but no UI ever collects one
all.why: photos/route.ts:10 accepts caption; PlacementDetailClient.tsx:394 POSTs only { url }; the lightbox render (1284-1286) and notification caption branch can never fire.
all.fix: Add a caption input at upload, or strip the dead plumbing.

all.summary: Reviews accepted on pending/active placements despite wound-down-only design
all.why: placements/[id]/review/route.ts checks party membership and uniqueness but never placement.status; the header comment and the 7-days-post-collection cron both assume post-completion reviews.
all.fix: Reject reviews unless status is completed or cancelled.

all.summary: 'Tap to read your review' links to a page that renders no reviews
all.why: review route links bell/email to /placements/[id]; placement_reviews is read by nothing (only the insert and account-delete reference it), and PlacementDetailClient has zero review rendering.
all.fix: Render reviews on the placement page, or link the notification somewhere that shows them.

all.summary: Withdraw confirm names 'the artist' even when the artist is withdrawing
all.why: OffersList.tsx:564 hard-codes 'The artist will see this offer as withdrawn'; the component is shared by artist-portal/offers and venue-portal/offers.
all.fix: Use counterparty-neutral copy ('The other party will see...').

all.summary: Offer expiry stored and typed but never displayed, enforced, or expired
all.why: offers/route.ts:368 stores expires_at; offers/[id]/route.ts has no expiry check; nothing renders it; the only 'expired' writer is the checkout stock check (checkout/route.ts:101).
all.fix: Reject actions on time-expired offers at PATCH/checkout and show the deadline, or stop accepting the field.

all.summary: Stripe cancel_url points at /customer-portal/offers, which does not exist
all.why: offers/[id]/checkout/route.ts:202; the customer-portal directory has no offers page, and the buyer is a venue, so backing out of Stripe lands on a 404.
all.fix: Change cancel_url to /venue-portal/offers.
all.challenge: Duplicate of B31; deliberate cancel path, no money moved, recoverable by navigation.

all.summary: Sign-in CTA hard-codes next=/spaces?view=requests from every host page
all.why: ArtworkRequestsList.tsx:110; the component is also rendered by /artwork-requests (ArtworkRequestsClient.tsx), whose users are relocated to the /spaces tab after login.
all.fix: Pass the host page's path as the next target via a prop.

all.summary: 'Required for revenue share' unenforced; share>0 with QR off creates contradictory placement
all.why: artist artwork-request page and responses/route.ts schema allow proposedRevenueSharePercent>0 with proposedQrEnabled=false; [responseId]/route.ts:187 then creates revenue_share with qr_enabled=false since ?? only covers null.
all.fix: Validate the share-requires-QR pairing at submit and force QR on at accept.

all.summary: No duplicate-response guard or up-front closed-state on the respond page
all.why: artist-portal/artwork-requests/[id]/page.tsx never renders prior responses or checks req status; responses POST has no per-artist uniqueness, and each duplicate passes checkArtistOutreachCap, burning quota; closed briefs fail only at submit with 409.
all.fix: Show prior responses, disable resubmission, and gate the form when the brief is closed.

all.summary: Core-only insert fallback silently drops the artist's proposed terms
all.why: responses/route.ts:236-265 retries with coreRow, logs droppedColumns operator-side only, and still returns success:true; the artist sees 'Response sent' while fee/share/QR vanished. Environment-conditional.
all.fix: Return droppedColumns in the response and surface a warning to the artist.

all.summary: Accept-of-placement-response skips T9 address stamp and the review/subscription gates
all.why: [responseId]/route.ts:168-205 inserts status active with accepted_at but no collection_address (both placements PATCH and messages placement_response stamp it), no pending-review or subscription check, and work_title falls back to the brief title.
all.fix: Stamp the venue collection address and apply the same acceptance gates as the placements PATCH.

all.summary: Artwork-request accept/decline is bell-only: no email, no thread message
all.why: [responseId]/route.ts uses createNotification only for both branches; placements and offers mirror every state change into the dm thread and email, so an inbox-dwelling artist can miss an acceptance.
all.fix: Send the accept/decline email and write a status message into the dm conversation.

all.summary: Legacy existing_works 'order' can mint an accepted, payable £0.00 offer
all.why: fulfill/route.ts prices amount_pence as proposed_offer_amount_pence ?? proposed_commission_amount_pence ?? 0; checkout builds the Stripe line from offer.amount_pence with no positive-amount guard (Stripe would likely reject, but the bad offer row persists).
all.fix: Refuse the order branch when no positive amount exists on the response.

all.summary: Support-thread replies 404 unless a profile row owns wallplace-support
all.why: messages POST resolves recipients only via artist/venue profiles (route.ts:327-337); nothing in src/, supabase/, or scripts/ creates a wallplace-support profile, and MessageInbox keeps the reply box on support threads.
all.fix: Special-case support replies (route to /contact) or seed a profile owning the slug.

all.summary: Systemic requester_user_id vs proposed_by_user_id mismatch across every list-API consumer
all.why: GET /api/placements emits proposed_by_user_id (route.ts:289-304) while PlacementContextPanel, both portal placement pages, PlacementDirectionTag.directionFor, and PlacementActionItems all read requester_user_id, which production rows lack (schema-columns.json).
all.fix: Emit both names from the list API; one line restores respond buttons, direction tags, and declined copy.
all.challenge: Same workaround as F24: the detail page resolves the requester and shows respond actions, so the placement funnel completes despite list-surface gaps.

all.summary: AdminPortalLayout metadata check contradicts server admin predicate
all.why: AdminPortalLayout.tsx redirects unless userType==='admin' (from user_metadata via AuthContext.tsx:150); admin-auth.ts userIsAdmin (ADR 0008) uses only env allowlist plus admin_users. A table-only admin passes AdminGate then bounces to /login.
all.fix: Drop the metadata check in AdminPortalLayout, or gate on the whoami response AdminGate already fetched.

all.summary: No Refunds sidebar item despite live admin refund-approval API
all.why: AdminPortalLayout.tsx navItems has no Refunds entry; /api/refunds/process exists and 403s artist-initiated requests pending admin action. Same underlying gap as G28.
all.fix: Add a Refunds admin page plus nav item calling /api/refunds and /api/refunds/process (G28's fix).
all.challenge: Missing nav item only; the substantive gap is G28. Admin inconvenience.

all.summary: Stats route 500s entirely on orders failure, contradicting its comment
all.why: lib/finance/revenue.ts fetchOrders throws on query error; grossMerchandiseValuePence runs inside the single try/catch in api/admin/stats/route.ts, so a broken orders table fails the whole response despite the 'degrades independently' docblock.
all.fix: Catch the GMV call and return zeros for that section, or correct the comment.

all.summary: Accept modal promises an invite email unconditionally
all.why: admin/applications/page.tsx:81 says 'An invite email will be sent.'; api/admin/applications/[id]/route.ts only calls inviteUserByEmail when findUserByEmail misses; existing accounts get the approval email only.
all.fix: Change the modal body to 'They will be emailed.'

all.summary: Accept clobbers existing account's role metadata to artist
all.why: api/admin/applications/[id]/route.ts:129 unconditionally sets user_type:'artist', display_name, artist_slug on existing accounts, so a venue-role applicant loses that identity. Whether unrelated keys survive depends on GoTrue merge semantics; the role clobber is certain.
all.fix: Read the existing user's metadata and merge, refusing or warning when user_type is already another role.

all.summary: welcomeMessage and rejection feedback fields unreachable from admin UI
all.why: API reads body.welcomeMessage and body.feedback (route.ts:95,264) but admin/applications/page.tsx confirm modals via ConfirmContext have no text inputs, so every rejection sends only generic copy.
all.fix: Add an optional textarea to the accept/reject confirm dialogs and pass it through.

all.summary: Rejected applicants have no linked appeal route
all.why: ArtistApplicationRejected.tsx links only supportUrl; account/appeal/page.tsx covers suspensions and account decisions via appeals@wallplace.co.uk and asks for a case reference no application email carries. Likely intended (reapply in 6 months).
all.fix: Either add an appeal line to the rejection email or record the exclusion as deliberate.

all.summary: Artists admin page is read-only with no moderation tooling
all.why: admin/artists/page.tsx is a bare table; api/admin/artists/route.ts selects no review_status; OperationalPolicyViolationWarning and OperationalAccountRestricted appear only in registry.ts and their own template files, sent by nothing.
all.fix: Add review_status to the list now (S); schedule suspend/unpublish/contact actions post-launch.

all.summary: Venues admin page has no management actions
all.why: admin/venues/page.tsx contains one button (the expand chevron); no PATCH/POST calls anywhere on the page, so approve/suspend/edit/remove do not exist. Read-only CRM as flagged.
all.fix: Accept for launch with DB-side workaround; build venue actions with the artist ones.

all.summary: Curation status select misrenders reconciler-owned past_due/paused rows
all.why: admin/curation/page.tsx STATUS_ORDER omits past_due/paused, so the controlled select's value matches no option (renders blank/first option) and any change silently overwrites reconciler state via PATCH.
all.fix: Render the excluded status as a disabled selected option when the row holds it.

all.summary: Managed curation refund never refunds: Invoice.payment_intent gone on pinned API
all.why: stripe.ts pins 2026-03-25.dahlia; installed SDK's Invoice interface has payments but no payment_intent (verified in node_modules types); refund/route.ts:118-124 casts and skips the refund when null, marking the row cancelled with no email. Tests mock the legacy shape.
all.fix: List the invoice with expand:['data.payments'] and refund via payments.data[0].payment.payment_intent; update tests.
all.challenge: Admin-triggered, rare flow with a manual workaround (Stripe dashboard refund); kept P1 not P2 because the false cancelled-without-refund state is silent.

all.summary: Curation page drops the API's refunded-vs-cancelled distinction
all.why: refundRow in admin/curation/page.tsx ignores the mutate response and just calls load(), so a managed row with no paid invoice flips to Cancelled with no explanation of whether money moved, despite the API reporting refunded:false.
all.fix: Read the response and show 'Subscription cancelled, nothing to refund' vs 'Refunded £X'.

all.summary: Admin approves blogs seen only as a 200-character excerpt
all.why: admin/blogs/page.tsx renders payload title and excerpt only, no link or preview; approval publishes via api/admin/blogs/[id]. Minor nuance: resubmission inserts a fresh queue row with a new excerpt, but pending-row edits do go stale.
all.fix: Fetch and render body_markdown (or link a draft preview) in the queue row before the Approve button.

all.summary: Rejection reason promised to author is never surfaced to them
all.why: admin/blogs/page.tsx:49 prompt says 'visible to the author'; the reason lands only in moderation_queue.reason; artist-portal/blogs/page.tsx shows a bare 'Rejected' badge and nothing reads the column back.
all.fix: Surface the reason on the author's blogs list, or reword the prompt to 'internal'.

all.summary: No author notification on blog approve or reject
all.why: api/admin/blogs/[id]/route.ts sends no email and creates no notification on either decision (grep finds no sendEmail/notif); authors discover outcomes only by revisiting their list, unlike the applications gate.
all.fix: Send a decision email (new template) or in-app notification from the blogs PATCH.

all.summary: Blog edit API action unreachable; writes fake body_json structure
all.why: Page has only Approve/Reject buttons; the edit branch (route.ts:98-126) is invocable only by hand-crafted calls and writes body_json {type:'doc', body: markdown}; public rendering reads body_markdown (blog/[slug]/page.tsx:302), so inert today.
all.fix: Remove the edit action and Edited tab, or leave documented as dead until an editor exists.

all.summary: Dispute conversation shown as raw API incantation, not a viewer
all.why: admin/disputes/page.tsx:139-141 renders literal 'GET /api/messages?dispute_id={id}' in a code tag; the admin-only server branch in api/messages/route.ts works but nothing in the portal calls it.
all.fix: Fetch the thread via authFetch and render it in the expanded dispute row.

all.summary: Resolution prompt says internal but text is emailed to both parties
all.why: admin/disputes/page.tsx:45 prompt reads 'visible internally'; api/admin/disputes/[id]/route.ts:109 emails the same text as the outcome in OrderDisputeResolved to buyer and artist. Candid internal shorthand would go straight to customers.
all.fix: Change the prompt to 'Resolution note (emailed to buyer and artist):'.
all.challenge: Harm requires an admin writing candid shorthand into a rare dispute flow; a one-line instruction to the admin avoids it entirely.

all.summary: Resolving non-order disputes notifies nobody
all.why: api/admin/disputes/[id]/route.ts:90 gates all notification on dispute.order_id; placement or conversation-only disputes get no email or in-app notice, so the opener must poll, the failure the 09 SD.2 fix targeted.
all.fix: Notify the dispute opener (opened_by_user_id) on resolve for disputes without an order_id.

all.summary: Escalate destroys the dispute's original category
all.why: route.ts:77 sets category='escalated', overwriting the classification the row heading displays; the note lives only in the audit context and no UI reads it back.
all.fix: Add an escalated boolean or separate flag column; keep category intact.

all.summary: Total subs MRR tile duplicates the MRR tile exactly
all.why: admin/financials/page.tsx lines 85 and 101-103 both render fmt(data.subscriptions.mrrPence); identical number under two labels.
all.fix: Delete the duplicate tile or repurpose it for managed-curation MRR.

all.summary: Failed payments tile counts current state, not failure events
all.why: api/admin/financials/route.ts:69-79 counts artist_profiles currently past_due bucketed by updated_at; any profile update moves rows between months and recovery erases history, so it is not a payment-failure count.
all.fix: Relabel as 'currently past due', or count invoice.payment_failed events from an event source.

all.summary: Top venues and artists listed as raw user-id UUIDs
all.why: financials/page.tsx:106-123 renders v.userId/a.userId in code tags; the API returns only {userId, totalPence} from venueSpendPence/artistEarningsPence, so no names reach the page.
all.fix: Join profile names/slugs server-side in the financials route.

all.summary: Money reconciliation exists only as an offline CLI script
all.why: scripts/audit/reconcile-money.ts with npm run audit:reconcile (package.json:26); no admin route or page invokes it, so ledger drift detection depends on someone remembering.
all.fix: Add a scheduled run or an admin endpoint surfacing the reconciliation result; runbook entry meanwhile.

all.summary: Feature-request Approved/Rejected tabs are permanently empty
all.why: api/admin/moderation/route.ts exports GET only; the sole queue-row status writes (api/admin/blogs/[id]) are scoped entity_type='blog', so feature_request rows can never leave pending.
all.fix: Remove the dead tabs now; add a decision endpoint when triage is needed.

all.summary: Feedback tabs equally dead; rows cannot leave pending
all.why: Same GET-only moderation API; no write path touches entity_type='feedback' rows, so admin/feedback/page.tsx Approved/Rejected tabs can never populate and the inbox cannot be cleared.
all.fix: Remove the dead tabs or share the decision endpoint with feature requests.

all.summary: Flagged-message moderation queue has no admin page
all.why: api/messages/route.ts:490 inserts entity_type:'message' rows and the moderation GET whitelist includes 'message' (route.ts:14), but no page queries it; flagged abusive messages accumulate unseen.
all.fix: Add a Messages tab or page reusing the feature-requests queue pattern with entity_type=message.
all.challenge: Users' abuse reports insert moderation_queue rows no page reads; reports silently vanish with no admin surface. A safety funnel dead end-to-end.

all.summary: Complete refund-request money path has no admin surface
all.why: Only artist-portal/orders and customer-portal call /api/refunds*; artists are 403'd on their own requests (process/route.ts:94), so artist-initiated refunds can only be approved by hand-crafted admin API calls.
all.fix: Build an admin Refunds page listing /api/refunds with approve/reject via /api/refunds/process.
all.challenge: Rubric-exact admin inconvenience with manual workarounds: the process API is callable directly and Stripe dashboard refunds work; launch refund volume near zero. Needs a runbook.

all.summary: Audit-blocks-response guarantee on dispute message reads is dead code
all.why: recordAdminAction (admin-audit.ts) catches internally and never throws, and Supabase insert errors resolve rather than throw, so the try/catch and 500 'Audit log failed' branch in api/messages/route.ts:70-80 can never fire.
all.fix: Add a throwing recordAdminActionOrThrow that checks the insert error, and use it there.

all.summary: admin_audit_log is write-only; no portal surface reads it
all.why: grep finds admin_audit_log only in admin-audit.ts inserts and route comments; no page or GET endpoint reads it, so the trail is inspectable only via direct DB access.
all.fix: Accept for launch (DB access suffices); add a read-only audit page later.

all.summary: Login-page OAuth silently creates customer accounts with no role choice or terms record
all.why: login/page.tsx lines 246-295 mint oauth-sign-state with role customer and never call /api/terms/accept; oauth-finalize stamps user_type customer for brand-new users. Recoverable via /apply; terms gap overlaps H15.
all.fix: Route login OAuth through the signup role/terms surface, or record terms server-side in oauth-finalize.

all.summary: Admin accept wipes user metadata and force-flips customer accounts to artist
all.why: admin/applications/[id]/route.ts:129 does call updateUserById without spreading, but GoTrue shallow-merges user_metadata top-level keys, so provider keys survive. The force-flip to artist (losing /customer-portal) is real and unannounced.
all.fix: Keep the flip but email the converted user; drop the metadata-loss half, merge semantics already protect it.

all.summary: Portal switch forces sign-out plus password re-entry; hint param is dead
all.why: Header.tsx:816-823 signs out and pushes /login?email=&hint=; login/page.tsx reads only ?email (line 34), nothing reads hint; OAuth-created accounts have no password so the pre-filled form cannot complete.
all.fix: Read hint on login to show role guidance and surface the OAuth buttons; later, tokened account switching.

all.summary: Admin sees Artist Portal header label linking to a portal that bounces them
all.why: Header.tsx:160 defaults portalBase to /artist-portal for any non-venue/non-customer role; the label ternaries at lines 731 and 947 have no admin case, so PortalGuard bounces admins to /admin with a toast.
all.fix: Add an admin branch: label Admin, link /admin.

all.summary: Mobile marketplace tabs never use the public variant for logged-out visitors
all.why: Header.tsx:917 selects only venueMarketplaceTabs or the default set; the public variant with How It Works and Blog exists at lines 111-112 but only the desktop branch passes it.
all.fix: Pass the same three-way variant selection to the mobile tab branch.

all.summary: Portal dropdown parity comment stale; offers and artwork-request links missing
all.why: Header.tsx dropdown lists (lines 754-790) omit My Offers, Artwork Requests, Social Posts and flag-gated Blogs that ArtistPortalLayout.tsx:28-39 and VenuePortalLayout.tsx:15-16 both carry, despite the now-its-parity comment at line 751.
all.fix: Derive the dropdown from the shared sidebar nav arrays instead of duplicated inline lists.

all.summary: Header messages dropdown never loads conversations for customers
all.why: Header.tsx:218-236 resolves a slug only from /api/artist-profile then /api/venue-profile; customers have neither profile so resolvedSlug stays empty and the load effect at line 241 returns early forever.
all.fix: Hide the messages dropdown for customers until customer messaging exists.

all.summary: Every customer Messages surface dead-ends at a 403 API
all.why: CustomerPortalLayout.tsx:13 and the portal dropdown offer Messages; the page slugifies displayName; api/messages/route.ts returns 403 for non-profile slugs on GET (lines 107-109) and POST (314-315).
all.fix: Remove customer Messages nav, dropdown entry and page until customer conversations are built.

all.summary: Logged-out message CTA signs shoppers up into the dead messages page
all.why: MessageArtistButton.tsx:55-56 routes logged-out visitors to /signup/customer?next=/customer-portal/messages?artist=..., a page that 403s per H8, while logged-in customers correctly get /contact?artist=.
all.fix: Send logged-out visitors through the same /contact?artist= flow as logged-in customers.

all.summary: Demo login sets auth cookies nothing reads; portal tour bounces to login
all.why: api/demo/login/route.ts sets an sb-* httpOnly cookie claiming @supabase/ssr middleware reads it; package.json has no @supabase/ssr, no middleware.ts exists, and src/lib/supabase.ts uses default localStorage storage, so PortalGuard sees no session.
all.fix: Redirect to a client bridge page carrying tokens and call supabase.auth.setSession, or adopt @supabase/ssr.

all.summary: Soft demo guard's toast payload is read by no client code
all.why: No component or helper reads data.demo (repo-wide grep), so the message string is never shown, as claimed. But DemoBanner.tsx:58 already says changes aren't saved, the flag's own accept-and-say-so remedy.
all.fix: Surface data.demo as a toast in the shared authFetch mutate path.

all.summary: Server and banner demo env pairs can silently disagree
all.why: demo-guard.ts reads DEMO_*_USER_ID; DemoBanner.tsx:30-31 reads separate NEXT_PUBLIC_ mirrors; nothing validates agreement, only scripts/seed-demo-accounts.ts prints both for manual copying.
all.fix: Add a build or startup check asserting the mirrored pairs match.

all.summary: ?demo=1 makes any real artist's profile claim demo, hiding Message and Buy
all.why: browse/[slug]/page.tsx:163-167 ORs the query flag into isDemoProfile for any slug, so a crafted link removes a real artist's CTAs and shows tour copy.
all.fix: Honour ?demo only when slug matches DEMO_ARTIST_SLUG or outside production.

all.summary: Pre-signup terms acceptance rows are forgeable; fix awaits owner decision
all.why: api/terms/accept/route.ts documents it in full: the pre-signup branch must trust the body email (no session exists yet) and states the sound fix, recording post-confirmation, is an owner legal-trail decision.
all.fix: Owner decides; then record acceptance after email confirmation from the verified token.

all.summary: OAuth signups never record terms acceptance server-side
all.why: terms/accept callers are only the three signup pages' password submit handlers plus ApplicationForm; the customer and artist OAuth branches skip it and oauth-finalize/route.ts contains no terms call, so OAuth users have no terms_acceptances row.
all.fix: Record platform_tos in oauth-finalize when stamping a new OAuth user's role.

all.summary: No mechanism exists to demand terms re-acceptance when versions change
all.why: Only terms/accept writes terms_version; no current-version constant, login check or portal gate exists; LegalTermsUpdate/LegalPrivacyUpdate are registered in emails/registry.ts:355-356 with no send site anywhere.
all.fix: Accept for launch; build a version-gate and broadcast when terms first change.

all.summary: Suppression list is decorative; nothing ever writes email_suppressions
all.why: email/send.ts:92 is the only reader; src/app/api/webhooks contains only stripe and supabase; no Resend bounce/complaint webhook exists, so hard bounces and complaints never populate the table.
all.fix: Add a signature-verified Resend webhook inserting email_suppressions rows on bounce and complaint.

all.summary: One-click unsubscribe header targets a POST-less page and is unsigned
all.why: send.ts:229 points List-Unsubscribe at /account/email/unsubscribe, a page.tsx with no POST handler, so RFC 8058 one-click fails; the API route accepts bare u and c unsigned, and eslint-rules/public-routes.js:43 falsely claims a signed token.
all.fix: Point the header at /api/account/email/unsubscribe and HMAC-sign the userId/category pair.
all.challenge: Header one-click is bulk-sender-scale deliverability, not the legal path; verified mailto arm exists and the header URL does carry u. C24 (kept P0) is the compliance gate.

all.summary: Suspicious-login email has a receiver but no known sender
all.why: webhooks/supabase/route.ts:85 handles auth.suspicious_login, but nothing in the repo emits it and stock Supabase auth has no such event; firing depends on an unverifiable dashboard-side custom hook.
all.fix: Wire a Supabase auth hook or mark the template dormant in OUTSTANDING.

all.summary: Message notification emails link every recipient to the artist portal
all.why: email/notifications.ts:58 hardcodes conversationUrl to /artist-portal/messages?c= for all recipients; a venue clicking it gets PortalGuard-bounced to /venue-portal, losing the conversation deep link.
all.fix: Pass the recipient's portal base into sendMessageUnreadEmail from each call site.
all.challenge: Every venue message-notification email deep-links /artist-portal; PortalGuard bounces venues, losing the conversation. Broken notification links across the core messaging loop.

all.summary: Trial-ending billing warning is categorised as opt-in promotions
all.why: webhooks/stripe/route.ts:1391 sends subscription_trial_ending as category promotions; categories.ts:44 makes that preference-gated (default off) and throttled 2/720h, so most users are charged with no warning delivered.
all.fix: Recategorise subscription_trial_ending as orders_and_payouts.
all.challenge: No trial can end until a full trial period after launch, so a fix window exists before any user is charged unwarned. Fix-soon, not a gate.

all.summary: Inactive re-engagement emails ship hardcoded zero stats
all.why: cron/inactive-users/route.ts hardcodes profileViews 0 (line 97), zeroed portfolioStats (110), empty suggestedArtists (150) and recommendedWorks (186), telling returning users they had zero activity regardless of truth.
all.fix: Compute real counts or strip the stats blocks from the inactive templates.

all.summary: Artist weekly digest ships empty topWorks and mislabelled message counts
all.why: cron/weekly-artist-digest/route.ts:69 always sends topWorks []; lines 70-73 are canned actions; line 43 filters messages on is_read=false at send time, so read messages vanish from the received count and threshold.
all.fix: Drop the is_read filter; populate topWorks or remove that template section.

all.summary: Venue weekly digest hardcodes zero artist matches
all.why: cron/weekly-venue-digest/route.ts:64 sends artistMatches: 0 and line 67 suggestedArtists: [] on every send, so the template's matches panel is permanently dead weight.
all.fix: Remove the matches panel from the template until matching exists.

all.summary: Daily cron slot burned on a job that can only skip
all.why: cron/placement-ending-soon/route.ts returns an honest skip because placements has no end-date column (D60), yet vercel.json:5 still schedules it daily at 10:00 UTC pending an owner decision.
all.fix: Owner picks: build placements.end_date and re-enable, or delete cron entry plus template.

all.summary: Inactive sweep: fake zero stats, admins mailed as customers, 1000-user cap
all.why: All three sub-claims hold in cron/inactive-users/route.ts: hardcoded zeros (97, 110, 150, 186); the customer branch (175+) catches any user without artist/venue profile rows, including admins; line 62 fetches one listUsers page of 1000.
all.fix: Strip fake stats, exclude admin-role users, and paginate listUsers.
